### [1] [PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07478)
*Jagpal Singh Jhala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PragyaDoc是一个通用文档智能框架，通过四层流水线解决印度22种官方语言造成的医疗文档可访问性障碍，使以英语为主的医疗文档能被农村人口、ASHA工作者和患者家属理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度22种官方语言造成了严重的医疗可访问性障碍——绝大多数医疗文档仅以英语存在，而最迫切需要这些信息的群体（农村人口、ASHA工作者、患者家属）在功能上被排除在理解之外。

Method: 提出一个四层流水线框架PragyaDoc：1)并行集成OCR提取层，2)几何-词汇融合层，3)确定性领域结构化层，4)双LLM医疗推理与本地化层。

Result: 该论文尚未提供具体实验结果，但提出了一种通用的文档智能框架来弥补医疗文档的语言可访问性差距。

Conclusion: PragyaDoc旨在通过多层次的文档智能处理流水线，将英语医疗文档转化为可被多语言人群理解的形式，从而打破语言障碍，提升印度基层医疗信息的可及性。

Abstract: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

</details>


### [2] [NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07541)
*Yiyao Chen,Yucheng Li,Jungong Tong,Shaoqi Wang,Kunhao Zhou,Ziquan Wei,Monica Murea,Marissa DiPiero,Tingting Dan,Guorong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroPilot是一个多智能体系统，将神经影像处理、质量控制和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能模块，自主编排工作流，已在17个队列（超过12.3万受试者）中部署验证，将传统2-3个月的处理时间压缩至一周。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始神经影像档案转化为可分析数据依赖三个脆弱的阶段：数据标准化、模态特异性预处理和质量控制。虽然单个神经影像工具发展成熟，但其编排需要项目特定脚本、环境自适应调优和大量人工QC，缺乏统一的自动化解决方案。

Method: NeuroPilot采用多智能体架构，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理的专业知识建模为三个LLM可调用的技能：dcm2bids-skill（数据标准化）、neuroimage-pre-skill（模态特异性预处理）和qc-agent-skill（质量控制）。LLM驱动的智能体自主编排工作流，将多样化的基础设施设置统一为单一配置，并通过3D浏览器仪表板实现基于证据的半自动QC和多层级验证系统。

Result: 系统在17个队列（>123,000受试者，涵盖婴幼儿到老龄化人群及多种MRI模态）中部署验证。QC代理筛查了558个生产受试者，自动标记与FreeSurfer拓扑缺陷指标一致；婴幼儿处理流程在QC验证输入上达到100%（201/201）完成率；将传统2-3个月的处理和培训时间压缩至一周。

Conclusion: NeuroPilot通过引入LLM驱动的多智能体编排，成功解决了神经影像处理流程中自动化程度低、可扩展性差的问题，实现了跨队列、跨模态、跨年龄段的通用部署，显著提升了神经影像数据处理的效率和可复现性。

Abstract: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

</details>


### [3] [Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07543)
*Joshua C. Vences,William T. Tran,Nikko Gimpaya,Catharine M. Walsh,Rishad J. Khan,Robert Bechara,Asher C. Wiggins,Celine N. Rousan,Kaitlyn V. G. L. Morgado,Angie Ibrahim,Kevin H. M. Kuo,Daniel von Renteln,Alexander Hann,Dennis L. Shung,Michael A. Scaffidi,Charles Ménard,Joshua Landy,Samir C. Grover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了五种多模态大语言模型（Claude Opus 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o、GPT-5）在结直肠息肉光学诊断中的准确性，结果显示所有模型在区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉方面F1分数均>0.9，但整体性能未达到ESGE标准，仍需前瞻性多中心试验和人工干预工作流设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断对指导切除策略和监测方案至关重要，多模态大语言模型在基于图像的诊断中展现出潜力，但缺乏对其诊断准确性的系统评估。

Method: 使用PRIME数据集的132个病例（白光和窄带成像图像），评估五种MLLM在Paris分类、NICE分类和预测组织学方面的F1分数、正确百分比和准确率，并与专家响应进行比较，使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析模型间差异。

Result: 所有MLLM在区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉时F1分数均>0.9；Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分侵袭性与非侵袭性息肉（0.560）和低/高级别腺瘤（0.492）方面F1分数最高；Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在Paris分类中的正确百分比显著高于其他模型（41.7%）。

Conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面表现最佳，最接近专家共识，但敏感性和特异性未达到ESGE标准，临床部署前需进行前瞻性多中心试验并设计人工参与的工作流。

Abstract: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [4] [LHSDet: High-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection via Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07863)
*Qian Yao,Jun-Jie Huang,Yongjun Wang,Luming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为LHSDet的高分辨率AI生成图像检测器，将检测任务建模为视觉问答问题，通过三支架构（低级视觉分支、高级视觉分支和语义级文本分支）融合多模态特征，有效捕捉低层纹理细节和高层语义信息，在多种扩散模型和自回归模型上展现出高检测精度和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法通常对图像进行下采样处理，忽略了高分辨率AI生成图像中关键的低层纹理细节，限制了检测性能；同时，层出不穷的未知生成模型使得大规模预训练数据集难以获取。

Method: LHSDet将AI生成图像检测任务转化为视觉问答问题，采用三支架构：1）低级视觉分支通过聚合非重叠补丁提取局部纹理线索；2）基于SigLIP2的高级视觉分支提取全局感知特征；3）基于BLIP-2的语义级文本分支生成描述并融合多模态特征。同时对视觉编码器进行重新设计以更好地捕捉低层和高层伪影。

Result: 大量实验结果表明，LHSDet在包括扩散模型和自回归模型在内的多种生成模型上均取得了高检测精度和鲁棒性能。

Conclusion: LHSDet通过视觉-语言多模态框架和专门设计的视觉编码器，有效解决了高分辨率AI生成图像检测中低层纹理细节丢失和未知生成模型泛化的问题。

Abstract: Driven by advances in diffusion models and autoregressive models, the fidelity and resolution of AI-generated images now rival those of real images. However, existing AI-generated image detection methods often downsample the images, inevitably overlooking critical low-level texture details in high-resolution AI-generated images, therefore limiting their detection performance. In addition, the ceaseless emergence of unknown generative models makes large-scale pre-training datasets inaccessible. To address these challenges, we propose a novel high-resolution AI-generated image detector, termed LHSDet. Specifically, we formulate the AI-generated image detection task as a Visual Question Answering problem, leveraging a fine-tuned vision-language framework to fully exploit the complementary information between visual and textual modalities. Recognizing that the default visual encoder of existing vision-language models is not tailored for AI-generated image detection, we redesign a visual encoder to better capture both the low-level and high-level artifacts inherent in AI-generated images. Furthermore, we incorporate a semantic-level textual branch to enable multi-modal feature fusion and detection. Consequently, LHSDet employs a triple-branch architecture to extract complementary multi-modal features: a low-level visual branch that aggregates non-overlapping patches for local texture cues, a high-level visual branch based on SigLIP2 for global perception feature extraction, and a semantic-level textual branch that generates captions using BLIP-2. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LHSDet achieves high detection accuracy and robust performance across diverse generative models, including both diffusion and autoregressive models.

</details>


### [5] [How Much Does It Cost to Answer My Question? Benchmarking Cloud VLM-based VQA Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07861)
*Henri Vanhuynegem,Weitao Xu,Yiran Shen,Guohao Lan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了VQABench，首个系统性地将客户端图像预处理作为受控变量来评估云VLM驱动VQA系统的基准。通过在3个VQA数据集和4个商业VLM上评估12种预处理技术（共95,168次API调用），发现预处理并非普遍有益，其效果取决于目标模型、API范式、提供商的token计费规则和任务表述等多个因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动VQA系统将推理卸载到云端VLM，使得客户端图像预处理成为关键优化变量，但现有的预处理技术对商业云VLM的成本-质量影响从未被系统研究过。

Method: 构建VQABench基准，将客户端输入预处理作为受控变量，在3个VQA数据集上对4个商业VLM（来自3个提供商）评估12种预处理技术，通过95,168次API调用进行系统性的成本-质量对比分析。

Result: 预处理并非普遍有益：其效果取决于目标模型、API范式、提供商token计费规则和任务表述。选择不当的预处理策略会增加部署成本或延迟，同时降低答案准确率。

Conclusion: VQABench阐明了预处理何时有效、何时失效及其原因，为VQA系统的未来研究和实际部署提供了指导性见解。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are becoming a practical backend for mobile visual question answering (VQA) systems, enabling smartphones and smart glasses to answer users' questions about the physical world. Since modern VLMs remain difficult to run on mobile and edge devices, VQA systems increasingly offload inference to cloud-based VLMs. This gives mobile devices access to stronger computation, but it also makes visual input preparation a key system variable: how the image is prepared before offloading affects not only answer quality but also payload size, token cost, and system latency. Proprietary APIs expose little control over model internals or serving behavior, leaving client-side preprocessing as the main practical optimization space for downstream developers. Many such techniques have been proposed for visual offloading, yet their cost-quality impact on commercial cloud VLMs has never been studied. To fill this gap, we present VQABench, the first systematic benchmark that treats client-side input preprocessing as a controlled variable for cloud-VLM-based VQA. We evaluate 12 preprocessing techniques across three VQA datasets and four commercial VLMs from three providers, totaling 95,168 API calls. Our results show that preprocessing is not universally beneficial: its effectiveness depends on the target model, API paradigm, provider token-accounting rule, and task formulation. A poorly selected preprocessing strategy can increase deployment cost or latency while degrading answer accuracy. Overall, our benchmark clarifies when preprocessing helps, when it fails, and why, providing insights to guide future research and real-world deployment of VQA systems.

</details>


### [6] [Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07547)
*Yuhao Lu,Weichen Zhang,Wenyi Xiao,Haohui Chen,Yiyun Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LayoutDSL，一个基于LLM的室内场景布局生成框架，通过领域特定语言（DSL）作为结构化动作空间来学习布局策略，并以监督微调和强化学习优化策略，显著提升空间合理性和设计逻辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内布局生成方法存在两个核心问题：一是将房间条件简化为粗粒度3D边界框，忽略了门窗等结构元素；二是将布局推理建模为连续坐标回归，阻碍模型学习智能布局设计的底层逻辑。

Method: LayoutDSL采用领域特定语言（DSL）作为布局推理的符号化动作空间，每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策。构建了3D-FrontDSL数据集（房间结构标注配合同步生成的DSL动作序列）用于监督微调；同时设计了基于室内设计原则和物理合理性约束的奖励机制，通过强化学习优化策略，使策略更具泛化性和可扩展性，并提供可验证的反馈。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面相比强基线和现有方法均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 将布局生成从连续坐标回归转化为DSL动作空间中的结构化决策学习，并结合可验证的奖励反馈进行强化学习，能够有效提升室内布局生成的质量。

Abstract: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

</details>


### [7] [EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08066)
*Junsik Jung,Seokryun Choi,Yoonki Cho,Woo Jae Kim,Andrew Jeong,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EvBS，一个事件引导的模糊合成框架，利用事件相机的高时间分辨率解耦运动与视觉内容，通过内在模糊合成和外在模糊合成两种互补策略生成多样化训练对，用于校准预训练去模糊模型以适应目标域，在多个基准上有效提升了去模糊模型的领域适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练去模糊模型在真实场景中因训练与测试分布之间的领域偏移而性能下降，现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容的内在耦合，难以有效生成多样化的训练数据来适配目标域。

Method: EvBS框架包含两种互补策略：1) 内在模糊合成——利用目标域锐利内容自身的运动模式生成模糊图像；2) 外在模糊合成——将模糊块中的运动模式迁移到不同的锐利内容上。通过事件相机的高时间分辨率实现运动与内容的解耦，从而打破自然耦合约束，生成多样化训练对。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EvBS有效增强了现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性，提升了领域自适应的去模糊性能。

Conclusion: EvBS通过事件相机的运动-内容解耦能力，提供了一种有效的领域适配方案，能够显著改善预训练去模糊模型在目标域上的泛化表现。

Abstract: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.

</details>


### [8] [SCoPE: Training-Free Audio-Visual Event Perception via Sparse Cross-Modal Prior Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07923)
*Jaemo Jeong,Junho Yoon,Hyunju Kim,Dongman Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SCoPE，一个无需训练的音频-视觉事件感知（AVEP）框架，通过让所有查询标签竞争共享证据并让双模态互相引导事件选择，解决了"虚假共激活"（FCA）问题，即在LLP数据集上比AV²A提升Type@seg 7.45点、Event@seg 5.04点，且可无修改迁移到其他数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练-free的AVEP方法通过匹配冻结的音频与视觉特征和文本编码事件名来查询事件词汇，但相关标签共享证据，导致错误标签的得分可能不低于正确标签（被称为虚假共激活FCA）。由于无法用标量阈值同时拒绝错误标签并保留所有正确标签，类特定阈值虽能阻止错误标签成为最终预测，但FCA仍存在于底层得分向量中，这一问题亟待解决。

Result: 在LLP数据集上，SCoPE相对已报道的AV²A结果提升Type@seg 7.45点、Event@seg 5.04点。同一固定配置无需修改即可迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k数据集，显示了良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to recover high-fidelity high-resolution videos from low-resolution inputs and is central to applications ranging from mobile capture to streaming and archival restoration. Existing approaches trade off among local-detail fidelity, long-range spatio-temporal modeling, perceptual realism, and efficiency: convolutional alignment techniques preserve local structure but suffer when motion is large or degradations are complex; transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies yet require architectural or algorithmic adaptations to remain computationally feasible; and recent latent or diffusion-based generators synthesize rich texture but require specialized temporal constraints to maintain coherence. We present MotionCraft, a controllable VSR framework that formulates restoration as motion-aware latent state prediction inspired by world models and integrates adaptive sparse attention with an explicit user-accessible control interface. MotionCraft combines robust motion fusion, a Latent World Transformer that balances locality and targeted non-local interactions, and a compact conditional decoder to deliver temporally consistent, high-quality reconstructions under streaming constraints. Empirical evaluations show that MotionCraft achieves strong reconstruction and perceptual performance while enabling predictable trade-offs between temporal smoothness and reconstruction fidelity.

Abstract: In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

Abstract: Retinal fundus images frequently exhibit multiple co-occurring pathologies, yet standard deep learning classifiers apply static, identical computation to every image regardless of the underlying disease distribution. Expert allocation is significantly disease-dependent (p < 0.001), with the healthy Normal state and morphologically distinct pathologies (e.g., ERM, AMD) isolating to dedicated experts. *Akash Gogineni,Nagur Shareef Shaik,Aasrith Mandava,Adnan Masood,Dong Hye Ye*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在CheXpert上达到0.895の宏平均AUROC，优于上下文门控基线。收益集中在高度共现且空间证据模糊的类别上（Atelectasis提升+1.5），且额外开销仅为一次线性投影和一个C×C边矩阵。

Abstract: Thoracic pathologies rarely occur in isolation, yet standard multi-label classifiers rely on shared global descriptors, discarding \emph{where} findings lie and \emph{how} they co-occur. We propose \textbf{C$\mathbf{^2}$A} (Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention), a classification head that explicitly couples spatial evidence with clinical priors. First, C$^2$A casts pooling as an expectation over learned per-class spatial attention maps, yielding localized descriptors for each disease. Second, it couples these descriptors via a learnable graph warm-started from empirical label co-occurrence. A single residual message-passing step shares evidence among related findings, proving to be a bounded perturbation of the identity where co-occurrence enters each logit through an explicit bilinear interaction. </details>

*Jiahui Cui,Yan Zhao,Kan Wei,Enze Zhu,Peirong Zhang,Lei Wang,Yiru Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在GeoText-1652基准和未见过的ERA数据集上的大量实验表明，GRASP在无人机视角细粒度图像-文本检索中取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了其在空中场景跨模态理解中的有效性。

Conclusion: GRASP框架通过粒度感知的区域对齐和语义原型学习，有效解决了无人机视角下跨模态理解的宏观和微观双重挑战，为空中视觉-语言导航提供了可靠的细粒度跨模态理解方案。

Abstract: Fine-grained cross-modal understanding in drone views is essential for aerial vision-language navigation. However, the inherent wide field of view and overhead perspective of drone scenarios impose dual challenges on vision-language understanding. At the macro level, overwhelming background clutter in visual representations leads to Cross-Modal Focus Misalignment, where the model prioritizes global environmental similarities over specific object details. At the micro level, Visual Isomorphism creates ambiguity, where candidates share similar geometric structures yet differ only in subtle attributes. To address these challenges, we propose the Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype (GRASP) learning framework, enhancing discriminative capability through two synergistic strategies. Specifically, we introduce Region-Focused Alignment (RFA) to promote object-centric cross-modal alignment while suppressing background interference. Concurrently, to tackle visual isomorphism, we propose Semantic Perturbation Enhanced Matching (SPEM), which leverages a foreground-purified Semantic Prototype Codebook (SPC) to construct semantically perturbed negatives for fine-grained semantic discrimination. Extensive experiments on the GeoText-1652 benchmark and the unseen ERA dataset demonstrate that GRASP achieves competitive performance in drone-view fine-grained image-text retrieval, validating its effectiveness for cross-modal understanding in aerial scenarios. </details>

*Nafis Fuad,Xiaodong Qian,Dongxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市洪水对交通基础设施构成日益严重的威胁，但目前没有任何运营系统能够在街道级别实时提供厘米分辨率的洪水深度估算。现有方法缺乏精确、实时的洪水深度估计能力，亟需开发新的技术方案。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. Abstract: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. We further introduce a temporal replay buffer to reuse informative segments while controlling policy staleness. Experiments on several multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that MBPO outperforms representative baselines, improving both learning signal quality and optimization efficiency. Abstract: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Abstract: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation is valid in a controlled ChestMNIST study at 64x64, crossing discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We retrain the vocabulary-1024 interaction block at three seeds and the interaction survives (6 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceed three seed standard deviations), and we scope the wider single-seed grid accordingly. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. On LFQ-1024, retuning D3PM and SE-D3PM (selected on a held-out validation split) moves them from default FID-192 0.44/0.41 to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds; the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. We report FID-192 as an internal ranking metric; it ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.80) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.78). We interpret these results through a rate-distortion-modelability framing, where modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. All experiments are at 64x64 on low-resolution medical-style images, unconditional, and evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and we scope every claim to that setting. TL;DR: 本文提出ViWi框架，通过物槽（material slots）聚合同材质体素的证据，并融合WiFi射频描述符来消除视觉歧义，实现更准确、物理一致的体素级力学属性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭视觉估计体素级力学属性（杨氏模量、泊松比、密度）本质上是病态的，因为视觉相似物体可能具有截然不同的材料构成和物理行为。现有方法独立预测各体素属性，忽略了真实物体的分段常数材料结构，导致共享同一材料的体素产生噪声或不一致的估计，且缺乏消除视觉歧义的显式机制。

Method: ViWi采用物体中心框架，用一组紧凑的材料槽（material slots）表示每个物体，聚合来自共享材料身份的体素证据，并产生一致的槽级属性预测。为补充视觉外观，ViWi通过WiFi频段电磁仿真（利用介电常数和电导率）生成紧凑的RF描述符，该描述符为材料槽提供全局组成线索（这些线索可能无法从图像获得），而视觉特征则保留体素级空间定位。

Conclusion: 结合物体中心的材料结构与互补的RF证据，能够实现超越纯视觉外观的更准确且物理一致的体素级属性估计。

Abstract: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Existing approaches predict these properties independently across voxels, overlooking the piecewise-constant material structure of real objects and producing noisy or inconsistent estimates for voxels that share the same material, while lacking an explicit mechanism to resolve visual ambiguity. We introduce ViWi (Vision Meets WiFi), an object-centric framework for volumetric mechanical-property estimation. ViWi represents each object using a compact set of material slots that aggregate evidence from voxels with a shared material identity and produce coherent slot-level property predictions. To complement visual appearance, ViWi incorporates a compact RF descriptor generated through WiFi-band electromagnetic simulation using permittivity and conductivity. The RF descriptor conditions the material slots with global composition cues that may be unavailable from images, while visual features preserve voxel-level spatial localization. Across volumetric mechanical-property and mass-estimation benchmarks, ViWi improves over the prior state of the art on four of six per-voxel metrics, while its vision-only variant improves all mass-estimation metrics. These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 超复数神经网络层结合幽灵迁移学习能够有效利用超复数运算带来的代数与几何优势，提升神经网络的信息表达与效率。代码已开源以便复现与进一步研究。

Abstract: Hypercomplex numbers extend the concept of complex numbers by introducing additional imaginary components. Besides increasing dimensionality, operations on the imaginary parts provide algebraic and geometrical properties that can be beneficial for solving machine learning problems. In this paper, we show how to create hypercomplex-valued neural network layers where the real part corresponds to the output of a traditional real-valued layer. The additional imaginary parts of these hypercomplex-valued layers produce what we call ``ghost features,'' which contain enhanced information that is not present in the output of the real-valued layer. Moreover, ghost features can be effectively integrated into a trained neural network through a process we refer to as ``spooky transfer learning.'' This approach allows us to harness the richness of ghost features, leading to more efficient neural networks. The source code and Jupyter Notebook are available at https://github.com/mevalle/v-nets/.

*Saim Rehman,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BRUCE框架，用于系统评估视觉语言模型在图像受扰动（如模糊、低对比度）条件下的多模态推理鲁棒性，并引入RCI和T-RCI两个新指标来量化推理性能随扰动严重程度变化的退化速度，同时对化学和数学推理任务中的失败类型进行细粒度分类分析。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning.
  State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.

</details>

It decouples anomaly generation from background integration, preventing small anomalies from being overwhelmed.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in both anomaly generation quality and downstream detection performance.It achieves a relative IS(a) improvement of 45.86\% (from 1.81 to 2.64) on VisA and 37.70\% (from 1.22 to 1.68) on MVTec AD 2, while also improving the downstream pixel-level IoU by 4.22\% on VisA and AUROC by 6.55\% on MVTec AD 2. TL;DR: 本文提出将视觉-语言接地（grounding）重新定义为双向概念对应（bidirectional concept correspondence）问题，即在不预先给定文本短语的情况下，同时恢复图像与文本间所有视觉指称性文本片段与实例级图像分割之间的对应关系，并提出了基于预训练视觉语言模型的ConCor-1模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region. This setup assumes that the relevant linguistic unit is already known, overlooking a more basic challenge in grounded communication: determining which parts of the text are visually referential and how they correspond to entities in the image. We formulate grounding as $\textit{bidirectional concept correspondence}$ over an image-text pair. Given an image and its paired text, the goal is to recover all correspondences between visually referential text spans and instance-level image segments, without assuming that the relevant text spans are provided. This formulation unifies common grounding tasks, including phrase grounding, referring expression grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, by treating text segmentation, image segmentation, and cross-modal alignment as a single correspondence prediction problem. To address this task, we introduce $\textbf{ConCor-1}$, a grounding model built on top of a pretrained vision-language model. It uses learnable $\textit{bridge tokens}$ to represent candidate image-text correspondences and predicts, for each token, a text mask, an image mask, and a correspondence presence score. To train and evaluate this task, we convert diverse grounding and segmentation datasets into a unified correspondence format. </details>

TL;DR: 本文提出DeCo方法用于零样本工业异常生成，通过解耦异常结构与源产品，再将其与目标产品的正常纹理重新耦合，解决了现有方法中异常信息获取不准确和异常-产品融合不受控两大问题，在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上取得了新的SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测面临真实异常数据稀缺的严重挑战。现有的零样本工业异常生成方法存在两个关键局限：异常信息获取不准确，以及异常与产品的融合过程不可控，导致生成质量不佳。

Method: 提出DeCo框架，包含两个核心阶段：1) 异常信息获取阶段，采用Dual-Routing Flow (DR-Flow)将纹理不变的异常结构绑定到异常token上，同时通过Product-Invariant Flow (PI-Flow)并行约束防止异常token绑定源产品信息；2) 异常-产品融合阶段，采用混合注入机制将获取的异常结构与目标产品重新耦合，并引入Product Compatibility Correction (PCC)来补偿异常结构与产品之间的不兼容性。

Conclusion: DeCo通过显式解耦-重耦合的策略，实现了更准确和可控的零样本工业异常生成，为工业异常检测提供了高质量的训练数据增强方案。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection is severely hindered by the scarcity of real anomalous data.Zero-shot industrial anomaly generation addresses this by generating anomalies on specific products without requiring any of their real anomalous images. However, existing methods suffer from two critical limitations, i.e., inaccurate anomaly information acquisition and uncontrolled anomaly-product fusion.To overcome these challenges, we propose DeCo, which decouples the anomaly structure from its source product, and explicitly recouples it with the normal textures of the target product. During anomaly information acquisition,Dual-Routing Flow (DR-Flow) binds the texture-invariant anomaly structure to an abnormal token, while a parallel constraint, Product-Invariant Flow (PI-Flow), prevents the abnormal token from binding the source product. During anomaly-product fusion, we propose a hybrid injection to recouple the acquired anomaly structure with the target product, and Product Compatibility Correction (PCC) to compensate for the incompatibility between the acquired anomaly structure and the product. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeCo establishes a new state-of-the-art. Training downstream detection models on our generated data yields massive pixel AP improvements of 5.1\% on MVTec AD and 8.2\% on VisA. Code is available at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/DeCo.

</details>


### [62] [SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07916)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SegDem通过实例分割感知的结构预训练和跨任务解码器表示迁移，将图像重建与视觉理解统一起来，在Single-和Quad-Bayer去马赛克任务上取得了一致的性能提升，适用于卷积、Transformer和状态空间等多种骨干网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去马赛克方法主要将其视为像素级重建问题，仅依赖局部纹理、跨通道相关性和低级图像统计，忽视了重建与视觉理解共享同一物理世界结构这一关键洞察，导致无法充分利用场景的结构和物理信息。

Method: 提出SegDem框架，首先通过实例感知结构预训练学习区域和边界感知的表示，然后将解码器迁移到RAW条件重建；同时将分割和去马赛克条件特征锚定到共享的冻结DINOv2表示空间，以保持跨任务的结构一致性。该方法支持卷积、Transformer和状态空间骨干，统一处理Single-和Quad-Bayer去马赛克。

Result: 在合成、外部和具有挑战性的数据集上进行了大量实验，不同架构和CFA布局下均表现出一致的性能提升，验证了跨任务结构理解对去马赛克重建的有效性。

Conclusion: 重建与视觉理解是共享场景结构的互补视角，通过跨任务表示迁移（特别是利用分割任务的结构信息）可以显著提升低级图像重建任务的性能，SegDem框架验证了这一思路的普适性。

Abstract: Image demosaicing reconstructs a full-color image from incomplete color measurements produced by a sensor covered with a color filter array (CFA). Most existing methods formulate demosaicing as pixel-level reconstruction and mainly rely on local textures, cross-channel correlations, and low-level image statistics. Our core insight is that reconstruction and visual understanding can be viewed as complementary views of shared scene structure: both are grounded in the same underlying physical world, and therefore the structural and physical information inferred from an image should remain consistent across the two tasks. We instantiate this idea with instance segmentation and propose \emph{SegDem}, a cross-task decoder representation transfer framework for demosaicing. SegDem first learns region- and boundary-aware representations through instance-aware structural pretraining and then transfers the decoder to RAW-conditioned reconstruction. Segmentation- and demosaicing-conditioned features are further anchored to a shared frozen DINOv2 representation space to preserve structural organization across tasks. We instantiate SegDem with convolutional, Transformer-based, and state-space backbones for unified Single- and Quad-Bayer demosaicing. Extensive experiments on synthetic, external, and challenging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and CFA layouts.

</details>


### [63] [Forged Peer Judgments Mislead Multimodal LLM Judge Panels: Source-Blind Anchoring and Panel-Consensus Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07920)
*Yang Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了多模态LLM评判面板中"来源盲注锚定"（source-blind anchoring）这一文本级攻击面：被引用的同行视觉判断本身可能是不可信的。引用独立视觉判断会造成19-26个百分点的巨大锚定差距，而刻意生成的错误引述比自然发生的错误同行陈述更频繁地推翻原本正确的评判（1.5-2.7倍）。作者提出"面板共识验证"（panel-consensus verification）防御方法，能拦截84.9%的伪造攻击，将净危害降低97.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态LLM评判面板通过交叉引用同行评判来提升可靠性，但被引用的同行判断本身可能不受信任。现有研究忽视了这一攻击面，即来源盲注锚定效应可能被恶意利用，导致原本正确的视觉评判被错误引述所推翻。

Method: 作者设计了对照实验：在自我框架和同行框架下引用独立视觉判断，测量锚定差距；使用匹配内容、仅标签的控制组检验自我/同行标签本身是否能解释该效应；对比刻意生成的错误引述与自然发生的错误同行陈述的影响；最后提出面板共识验证方法，将引用与独立收集的盲投票进行交叉验证。

Result: 引用独立视觉判断产生19-26个百分点的锚定差距；标签控制组仅改变-0.17pp（95% CI [-0.68,0.35]），表明标签本身不能解释效应；刻意生成的错误引述比自然错误陈述更常推翻正确评判（1.5-2.7倍），bootstrap 95% CI排除并列情况；面板共识验证拦截84.9%的伪造攻击，净危害降低97.5%。

Conclusion: 来源盲注锚定是多模态LLM评判面板中的低成本攻击面，但通过面板共识验证可以有效防御。该方法保护了真实同行信息的正面价值（尽管点估计在统计上不显著），为更安全的多模态协作评估提供了具体方案。

Abstract: Multimodal LLM judge panels can cross-reference peers, but a quoted peer judgment may itself be untrusted. We expose source-blind anchoring as a text-level attack surface in vision-language model (VLM) panels. Quoting independent visual judgments creates large anchoring gaps (19--26 percentage points) under both self and peer framing. A matched-content, label-only control changes the broken rate by only $-0.17$pp (95\% CI $[-0.68,0.35]$), showing that the self/peer label itself does not explain the effect. Under our tested construction, deliberately generated, concise wrong quotes overturn originally-correct verdicts 1.5--2.7$\times$ more often than naturally occurring wrong peer statements, with bootstrap 95\% CIs excluding parity across two datasets and seven VLM judges. Because the two statement populations differ in selection and form, this ratio measures differential damage under the tested attack rather than a provenance-only causal effect. We then introduce panel-consensus verification, which cross-checks a quote against independently collected blind votes. It blocks 84.9\% of fabricated attacks, cuts their net harm by 97.5\%, and preserves the positive but statistically inconclusive point estimate for genuine peer information under leave-one-out re-verification. These results identify a low-cost attack surface and a concrete defense for safer multimodal collaborative evaluation.

</details>


### [64] [SportsGrounder: Proposal-Aided Interleaved Grounding for Dense Sports Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07932)
*Yizhi Li,Jiawei Jiang,Guanhong Wang,Yingcai Wu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SportsGrounder框架，通过开放词汇视觉专家和交错接地的机制，解决大语言多模态模型在密集体育视频推理中因缺乏细粒度视觉细节而过度依赖文本先验的问题，在SoccerNet和FineSports派生数据集上达到最先进精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集体育视频推理需要理解大量小尺度、高度交互且视觉同质化的实体（如穿着相同队服的球员和球），而现有LMMs缺乏细粒度视觉细节，容易过度依赖文本先验猜测答案，尤其在区分视觉相似的球员动作时表现不佳。

Method: SportsGrounder包含三个核心组件：1) 利用开放词汇视觉专家提取领域引导的目标提案实现精确空间定位；2) 交错接地融合（IGF）机制逐帧整合显式边界框坐标与隐式视觉语义及全局网格特征，保持严格时间对齐并防止序列长度爆炸；3) 动作感知监督（AAS）模块通过直接规范模型隐藏状态，强制学习准确的运动表示以减少语言偏差；最后使用混合偏好优化（MPO）更好地区分欺骗性干扰项。

Result: 在新构建的密集体育VQA数据集（源自SoccerNet和FineSports）上的大量实验表明，SportsGrounder显著提升了细粒度推理能力，并达到了最先进的准确率。

Conclusion: SportsGrounder通过显式空间接地与动作感知监督的结合，有效缓解了LMMs在密集体育视频场景中过度依赖语言先验的问题，验证了交错接地机制在细粒度视频推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Dense sports video reasoning, however, demands a fine-grained understanding of numerous small-scale, highly interactive, and visually homogeneous entities (e.g., players sharing identical uniforms, the ball) across long temporal contexts. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To address this, we propose \textbf{SportsGrounder}, a framework that leverages an open-vocabulary visual expert to aid interleaved grounding specifically for dense sports video reasoning. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. The IGF frame-by-frame integrates explicit bounding box coordinates and implicit visual semantics with global grid features. This design preserves strict temporal alignment and prevents sequence length explosion. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias. Optimized with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) to better distinguish deceptive distractors, our extensive experiments on newly curated dense sports VQA datasets (derived from SoccerNet and FineSports) demonstrate that SportsGrounder significantly improves fine-grained reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.

</details>


### [65] [FlexSplat: Flexible Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without Point Cloud Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07937)
*Amir Sabbaghziarani,Hanting Ye,Maria Gorlatova,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlexSplat是一种前馈框架，用于从无标定、以物体为中心的多视图图像集合进行新视图合成。它通过联合训练几何Transformer与高斯解码器来预测每张图像的相机参数和深度，消除了对相机位姿的依赖，在ShapeNet-SRN和GSO数据集上达到或接近有标定SOTA重构器的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于查询的方法（如query-based 3D高斯重建）在多视图变形注意力下能重建紧凑的3D高斯集，但都假设相机位姿已知。作者希望去除这一假设，实现无标定的前馈式高斯重建，从而简化实际应用中的流程。

Method: FlexSplat联合训练一个几何Transformer（预测每图像的相机参数和深度）与高斯解码器。深度引导高斯参数化，多视图可变形交叉注意力在所有输入视图间聚合证据形成视图一致的3D基元集合。使用不确定性加权的深度一致性目标函数让几何前端适应重建任务，解码过程中形成的跨视图共识吸收相机和深度的残差误差。高斯基元预算紧凑且与输入分辨率解耦。

Result: 在ShapeNet-SRN和GSO数据集上，FlexSplat匹敌或接近有标定的SOTA重构器，无需相机位姿或真值深度。在GSO上匹配最佳感知质量（LPIPS），且在PSNR上仅落后有标定方法0.7 dB以内。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合训练的几何前端足以让基于查询的高斯重建实现无标定操作，同时保持与有标定方法相当的定量和感知质量，验证了该路线的可行性。

Abstract: We present FlexSplat, a feed-forward framework for novel view synthesis (NVS) from uncalibrated, object-centric multi-view image collections. A recent line of query-based methods reconstructs a compact set of 3D Gaussians by treating them as transformer queries that are refined with multi-view deformable attention; these methods, however, assume that camera poses are given. FlexSplat removes this assumption: a geometry transformer is trained jointly with the Gaussian decoder to predict per-image camera parameters and depth, which in turn ground a depth-guided Gaussian parameterization and a multi-view deformable cross-attention that aggregates evidence across all input views into a single, view-consistent set of primitives. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.

</details>


### [66] [LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07941)
*Shangye Song,Tianzhi Zhu,Syed Ariff Syed Hesham,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LAD-COD框架，通过将指令条件化的语义目标引导与自下而上的层次化视觉特征对齐，解决伪装目标检测中前景与背景判别性低、边界证据弱的问题，在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个数据集上的12项指标对比中全部取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪装目标检测面临前景与背景视觉相似度高、边界弱等挑战，现有基于大型多模态模型的语言到掩码范式仅用目标嵌入引导掩码解码器，却未对需要保留低对比度边界和精细局部结构的密集视觉特征提供显式引导，导致语义信息无法充分帮助定位伪装目标。

Method: LAD-COD包含两个核心组件：一是可训练的层次化视觉分支，用于捕获伪装敏感的纹理、边界和上下文信息；二是语言对齐双视觉融合（LADVF）模块，将目标嵌入从稀疏提示扩展为查询patch级别的语言对齐特征，并通过门控机制将其残差集成到层次化特征中，使语义信息引导定位的同时保留精细结构细节。

Result: 在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个基准数据集上，LAD-COD在所有12个数据集-指标组合的比较中均取得最佳报告值，全面超越现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过语言对齐的密集视觉感知设计，LAD-COD验证了将自上而下的语义目标引导与自下而上的层次化视觉特征有效融合能够显著提升伪装目标检测性能，为语言到掩码范式在密集感知任务中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.

</details>


### [67] [SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07948)
*Zhennan Chen,Tianxing Shi,Pengcheng Xu,Kepan Nan,Qian Wang,Zili Yi,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynVAR是首个专为VAR范式设计的无需训练的图像生成增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播，包含全局引导、感受野约束和高频补偿三大组件，显著提升VAR在复杂多物体多属性场景下的建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR因其下一尺度预测范式广受欢迎，但在处理包含多个物体和属性的复杂场景时面临性能瓶颈。现有基于扩散的增强方法无法有效解决VAR特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题，因此需要专门针对VAR范式的增强方案。

Method: SynVAR包含三个关键组件：(1)全局引导（Global guidance），在早期阶段确保合理的空间结构；(2)感受野约束（Receptive field constraints），缓解早期阶段的语义混淆；(3)高频补偿（High-frequency compensation），恢复细粒度细节。三者协作实现空间-语义协同控制策略。

Result: 大量定量和定性实验表明，SynVAR显著提升了VAR在复杂场景建模方面的能力，有效增强了生成图像的质量。

Conclusion: SynVAR作为首个针对VAR范式的训练自由增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略有效抑制了跨尺度误差传播，为VAR在复杂场景下的生成质量提供了实质性改进。

Abstract: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

</details>


### [68] [LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07958)
*Wenbo Sui,Daniel Lichau,Harold Phelippeau,Zhao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LIBAD，这是首个面向锂离子电池电极制造的多模态异常检测基准，涵盖双面可见光成像、高分辨率X射线和低分辨率X射线三种弱相关模态。同时提出DA-Core方法，在coreset选择时联合考虑特征空间覆盖率和正常特征的局部密度，在0.05的coreset比例下将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，且推理时间减少43.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态工业异常检测主要针对离散产品，依赖RGB与3D强相关观测，而连续过程制造和弱相关传感模态（如可见光与X射线）尚未被充分探索，且缺乏相应的基准数据集。

Method: 提出DA-Core方法，是一种基于内存的方法，在coreset选择过程中同时考虑特征空间覆盖率和正常特征的局部密度，使紧凑内存库能更好地保留细粒度的正常变化。

Result: 在coreset比例为0.05时，DA-Core将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，优于标准最远点采样；同时超越了在0.20比例下获得的最佳标准coreset结果，并将推理时间减少43.9%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，针对过程制造设计异常检测方法时，需要显式考虑正常特征的数据分布以及模态间的关系。

Abstract: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

</details>


### [69] [Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07981)
*Liangliang Zhao,Junying Wang,Danni Yang,Yifan Chang,Bin Fu,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Yihao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PhyS，一个三阶段框架，用于将物理先验蒸馏到流式世界模型中。通过构建包含12万条真实物理交互视频的PhyS-120K数据集，经过物理感知监督微调注入先验到14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏为1.3B因果DiT，最后通过在线强化学习（含时序信用路由TCR机制）优化物理合理性。在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流式世界模型在长时程预测时常常违反基本物理约束。传统方法将预训练的双向DiT蒸馏为因果生成器，但存在两个根本局限：一是通用双向教师模型从视觉预训练中获得的物理先验有限；二是这些有限的先验在双向到因果的蒸馏过程中进一步损失。

Method: PhyS采用三阶段框架：(1) 构建PhyS-120K数据集，包含12万条真实物理交互视频，覆盖刚体动力学、软体形变、流体现象和相变，并为每条视频标注对象属性和因果状态转换的结构化描述；(2) 通过物理感知监督微调将物理先验注入14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏为轻量级1.3B因果DiT用于少步自回归流式生成；(3) 使用在线强化学习激励生成物理合理的卷展，并提出时序信用路由（TCR）机制处理时序信用分配问题，通过重叠时间窗口评估物理一致性并将组相对优势路由到时间对齐的去噪动作。

Result: 在PhysicsIQ基准上，PhyS相比Wan2.1-14B教师模型提升18.2%，相比Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。同时在VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench等物理感知视频基准上也有提升。

Conclusion: PhyS通过构建大规模物理交互数据集、物理先验注入和在线强化学习三阶段方案，有效解决了流式世界模型中物理约束违反的问题，验证了物理先验蒸馏范式的有效性。

Abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

</details>


### [70] [AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07982)
*Xu Zhang,Xinqing Li,Jianpeng Xie,Zeshuai Zhu,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaDINO是一个对冻结的DINO编码器进行对感知（pair-aware）骨架内适应的框架，通过双时相交互实现高效遥感变化检测。其核心组件CGLA在冻结块后耦合两个流并注入共享时间残差，BSCS通过批量共享通道块选择减少FFN计算量，CPGR解码器复用编码器侧变化响应进行由粗到细的预测。在四个基准上取得竞争性或更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于视觉基础模型（如DINO）的变化检测方法通常将双时相图像独立编码并事后比较，导致骨架网络无法感知跨时间关系，与遥感变化检测需要对双时相图像对进行推理的任务本质不匹配。

Method: 提出AdaDINO框架：1) CGLA模块在选定的冻结块后耦合双流特征，注入带相反符号的共享时间残差以增强真实变化响应并保持对中点；2) BSCS保留批共享的通道块子集以减少FFN计算且可紧凑执行；3) CPGR解码器复用编码器变化响应进行由粗到细预测。

Result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上达到竞争性或更优性能，在SYSU-CD上增益最大。移除62.5%的FFN隐藏宽度后，在SYSU-CD上仍获得85.29%的F1分数，并实现1.41倍吞吐量加速。

Conclusion: AdaDINO证明了在不微调大型视觉基础模型的情况下，通过骨架内双时相交互机制可以有效弥合VFM与变化检测任务之间的差距，实现高效且高性能的变化检测。

Abstract: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

</details>


### [71] [AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07984)
*Vasileios Tzouras,Paraskevas Pegios,Lazaros Nalpantidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了AgriField-40K农业田间图像数据集和AgriMAE参数高效持续预训练基线方法。AgriMAE通过在自然图像预训练的MAE模型上仅训练轻量适配器，实现迁移，并能以最多9倍少的可训练参数匹配甚至超越全量微调的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 田间农业计算机视觉对精准农业至关重要，但严重依赖昂贵的标注和大型预训练模型的高成本适配。作者希望构建一个实用的田间数据集，并探索参数高效的持续预训练方法，以降低农业视觉任务的落地成本。

Method: 构建了AgriField-40K数据集（整合17个公开资源，涵盖多种作物、杂草和田间条件）；提出AgriMAE基线方法，通过在自然图像预训练的掩码自编码器（MAE）上仅训练轻量适配器实现参数高效的持续预训练；并探索语义特征重建作为替代预训练目标。

Result: AgriMAE在多个下游任务上持续提升性能，能以最多9倍少的可训练参数匹配甚至超越全量微调的效果，验证了AgriField-40K在农业视觉持续预训练中的实用价值。

Conclusion: AgriField-40K是一个实用的农业视觉持续预训练资源，AgriMAE证明了参数高效适配策略在农业场景下的有效性，为低成本的农业视觉模型迁移提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. Building on this, we present AgriMAE, a parameter-efficient continual pretraining baseline that adapts a masked autoencoder pretrained on natural images by training only lightweight adapters. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. Project page: https://dtu-pas.github.io/agrifield40k/

</details>


### [72] [Advantage-Guided Gate: Reshaping Open-Ended Reasoning for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07987)
*Ling Lin,Yang Bai,Congcong Zhu,Jiangming Shi,Meng Wang,Yang Long,Jingrun Chen,Ling Shao,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种优势引导的门控框架（Advantage-Guided Gating Framework），用于动态干预和纠正多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间场景理解与推理任务中的推理偏差。该框架将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，通过蒙特卡洛价值评估提供中间监督信号，并设计步骤优势门与轨迹优势门分别选择高价值推理步骤和高质量推理轨迹。实验表明该框架能有效提升基准MLLMs在视觉空间理解与推理任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂空间场景理解和推理任务中展现潜力，但其开放式的推理过程容易产生决策错误和错误累积，导致答案质量不稳定，需要一种动态干预机制来纠正推理过程中的偏差。

Method: 将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，在推理树上引入蒙特卡洛价值评估提供中间监督信号。框架包含Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate两个门控模块，分别动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量完整推理轨迹。训练时利用多分支采样生成的推理树进行门控的监督学习，采用共享参数初始化与任务特定头结合的方式实现跨任务鲁棒性和多样性。推理时根据问题类型选择最优推理头并贪心选择高价值前缀推理步骤。同时构建了Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集并进行两阶段学习。

Result: 在Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集上进行两阶段学习后，大量实验表明该优势引导门控框架能有效提升基准MLLMs在视觉空间理解与推理任务上的性能。

Conclusion: 优势引导的门控框架通过动态干预推理过程、纠正推理偏差，有效增强了MLLMs在空间场景推理中的稳定性和准确性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.

</details>


### [73] [MRBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Human Motion-Text Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07993)
*Fulong Liu,Liang Xu,Chengqun Yang,Yuhao Zhang,Yichao Yan,Xiaokang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MRBench，一个全面的人体运动-文本检索基准，包含3,390个来自多源（动作捕捉、真实视频、合成视频、生成模型）的运动样本，覆盖118个细粒度类别，每个运动配有多粒度描述，共10,170条字幕。同时提出一种轻量级粒度感知检索模型，通过冻结标准字幕对齐模型并利用LLM生成的多粒度伪监督，提升了混合粒度检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动-文本检索基准存在三大缺陷：运动类型同质化（以室内运动为主）、类别分布不平衡、文本描述过于简单且重复，无法可靠评估跨域和跨粒度的语义对齐能力。

Method: 1) 构建MRBench：通过多阶段数据筛选流程（过滤与平衡候选样本、验证语义对齐、生成多粒度运动描述），汇集多种来源的运动数据；2) 提出粒度感知模型：在冻结的标准字幕对齐检索模型基础上，利用LLM生成的简洁和细粒度描述作为伪监督，训练额外的粒度特定运动提取器和文本适配器；3) 推理阶段采用粒度感知评分融合，在保持不同描述级别间评分可比性的同时整合全局与适配后的相似度。

Result: 在MRBench上对代表性检索基线进行广泛评估，揭示了显著的跨数据集泛化差距和对查询粒度的敏感性。提出的粒度感知模型在不牺牲标准字幕性能的前提下，提升了混合粒度检索的效果。

Conclusion: MRBench为运动-语言对齐评估提供了全面的测试平台，填补了现有基准在多源异构运动和多粒度语义对齐评估方面的空白，推动了运动语言对齐评估的发展。

Abstract: Human motion-text retrieval provides a rigorous means of assessing cross-modal alignment. Prevailing benchmarks are dominated by homogeneous indoor motions, imbalanced motion distributions, and oversimplified, repetitive texts, which hinder the reliable measurement of cross-domain and cross-granularity alignment. We thus introduce MRBench, a comprehensive motion-text retrieval benchmark featuring heterogeneous motions, broad and balanced category coverage, and reliable, discriminative, multi-granular descriptions. MRBench is constructed through a meticulously designed multi-stage data curation pipeline, which filters and balances candidates, verifies unambiguous semantic alignment, and generates motion-grounded descriptions at multiple granularities. The resulting benchmark contains 3,390 motions drawn from motion capture, in-the-wild videos, synthetic videos, and motion generative models, covering 118 fine-grained categories. Each motion is paired with concise, standard, and fine-grained descriptions, yielding 10,170 captions. Extensive evaluations of representative retrieval baselines on MRBench reveal a substantial cross-dataset generalization gap and pronounced sensitivity to query granularity. We propose a lightweight granularity-aware model anchored at a frozen standard-caption-aligned retrieval model. LLM-based concise and fine-grained captions provide pseudo-supervision for extra-branch granularity-specific motion extractors and text adapters. For inference, granularity-aware score fusion integrates global and adapted similarities while strictly maintaining score comparability across all description levels. The resulting model improves mixed-granularity retrieval without compromising standard-caption performance. We believe that our MRBench provides a comprehensive testbed for advancing motion-language alignment evaluation.

</details>

*Kutub Uddin,Nusrat Tasnim,Khalid Malik*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉Transformer的AIGI检测器通常采用加权求和策略聚合中间层表示，忽略了从浅层纹理到深层语义的层次化特征中固有的有序语义进展，导致检测性能受限。

Conclusion: PE-Mamba通过显式建模层次特征的顺序语义进展并结合双向扫描与全局聚合，在极小参数开销下实现了卓越的AIGI检测性能与跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: AI-generated image (AIGI) detection has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid advancement of generative models and the diminishing gap between synthetic and authentic content. Existing vision transformer-based detectors commonly rely on weighted-sum strategies to aggregate intermediate representations across transformer layers, often overlooking the inherently ordered semantic progression of hierarchical features from shallow texture cues to deep semantic representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{PE-Mamba}, a novel framework built upon a pre-trained PE-Core vision transformer with lightweight LoRA adaptation that introduces three complementary components for cross-layer feature aggregation and fusion. First, a bidirectional selective aggregator (BSA) processes layer-wise classification tokens through forward and backward selective scans, where the forward scan progressively accumulates shallow-to-deep forensic evidence, and the backward scan performs deep-to-shallow contextual refinement to reinterpret low-level cues in light of high-level semantic context. Second, a softmax-weighted aggregator (SWA) computes a learned global summary of all layer tokens as a complementary aggregation path. Third, a sigmoid-gated blend (SGA) adaptively fuses the BSA and SWA outputs via a learnable scalar gate, allowing the model to dynamically balance directional sequential evidence and global layer-wise aggregation. Extensive experiments on UniversalFakeDetect (96.6\% mACC, 99.5\% mAP) and AIGCDetect (95.3\% mACC, 98.1\% mAP) demonstrate that \methodname{} outperforms 18 detectors with superior generalization across diverse generative models, while training only 1.3\% of total parameters (0.13\% for LoRA alone).

</details>


### [75] [Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08009)
*Yichun Yeh,Yiheng Li,Xiaobo Hu,Zhen Lei,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于证据锚定的取证推理（EFR）框架，用于检测和定位多模态媒体操纵（DGM4），通过锚定-验证推理链和模态解耦优势路由机制，实现可解释、可验证的跨模态虚假新闻检测，并在性能上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DGM4检测方法多为黑盒，缺乏决策依据；MLLMs虽能提供可解释性，但存在两个难题：解释与预测证据位置脱节导致归因不可验证，以及统一训练信号无法区分定位token与分类token导致多头联合训练不可靠。

Method: 提出EFR框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）Anchor-and-Verify推理链，先进行模态隔离感知再进行跨模态比较，以结论坐标为显式锚点约束证据空间对应关系；（2）可验证奖励系统，在训练中强制证据-结论一致性；（3）模态解耦优势（MDA）路由机制，缓解预测任务间的信用分配错误。

Result: 实验表明EFR在DGM4任务上达到最先进的性能，同时能生成将解释与证据明确绑定的结构化取证推理记录。

Conclusion: EFR通过锚定证据与结论的空间一致性并优化多任务训练信号分配，成功解决了MLLM在虚假新闻检测中可解释性与可验证性不足的问题，实现了性能与可解释性的双重提升。

Abstract: Fake news increasingly relies on cross-modal image-text forgeries, making transparent and verifiable reasoning chains an urgent need for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4). Existing methods produce black-box detection results without any decision rationale, limiting their reliability in forensic practice. Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a natural path toward explainability, but applying them to DGM4 raises two difficulties. First, models tend to generate explanations disconnected from predicted evidence locations, producing unverified attribution. Second, enforcing evidence-conclusion consistency requires active optimization, yet uniform training signals fail to distinguish localization tokens from classification tokens, making multi-head joint training unreliable. We propose a multi-modal manipulation detector based on an Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning (EFR) framework. EFR introduces an Anchor-and-Verify reasoning chain that enforces modality-isolated perception before cross-modal comparison, with conclusion coordinates as explicit anchors to which downstream evidence must spatially correspond. A verifiable reward system then enforces evidence-conclusion consistency during training, while a Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) routing mechanism mitigats credit misassignment across prediction tasks. Experiments show that EFR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing structured forensic reasoning records that explicitly bind explanations to evidence.

</details>

*Jan Kulik,Bjarni Dagur Thor Karason,Yung-Hsu Yang,Boyang Sun,Marc Pollefeys,Xi Wang*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从第一人称视频理解3D场景对机器人和自动驾驶导航至关重要，但快速视点变化和部分遮挡使得构建结构化表示充满挑战。现有方法要么只处理显式交互，要么假设静态场景，难以捕捉复杂动态。

Method: 采用模块化框架，将2D分割掩码提升至全局3D坐标框架中，利用基于点的运动评分机制和基于体素的合并启发式算法来关联物体轨迹，从而实现对静态和动态物体的持续3D跟踪。

Result: 在Aria Digital Twin数据集上，相比最强基线在正确位置百分比（PCL）上实现了11%的提升。在退化的部署条件下，使用稀疏3D边界框估计替代密集深度图，并集成交互引导的动态关联，系统仍能保持准确的空间表示。

Conclusion: EgoTrack3D有效应对了第一人称视频中快速视角变化和部分遮挡的挑战，同时支持静态与动态物体的持久3D跟踪，并在噪声观测下表现出鲁棒性，为实际部署提供了更通用的解决方案。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scenes from egocentric video is fundamental for robotics and autonomous navigation, yet rapid viewpoint changes and partial occlusions make building structured representations challenging. Existing 3D tracking and scene graph construction methods primarily address explicit interactions or assume static scenes, limiting their ability to capture complex dynamics. We introduce EgoTrack3D, a modular framework that reconstructs and maintains a dynamic 3D scene representation directly from egocentric RGB video. The framework lifts 2D segmentation masks into a global 3D coordinate frame, using a point-based motion scoring mechanism alongside a voxel-based merging heuristic to associate object tracks. EgoTrack3D maintains accurate representations over time, achieving an 11% improvement in percentage of correct locations (PCL) relative to the strongest baseline on the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) dataset, while addressing the more general setting of persistent 3D tracking for both static and dynamic objects. Furthermore, to demonstrate the system's robustness under degraded conditions that simulate real-world deployment constraints, we replace dense depth maps with sparse 3D bounding box estimation and integrate interaction-guided dynamic association, enabling EgoTrack3D to maintain accurate spatial representations despite noisy observations.

</details>


### [77] [Evidence-RL: Towards Evidence-intensive Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08021)
*Haojie Huang,Xinlei Yu,Chengming Xu,Zhangquan Chen,Cheng Yang,Qingdong He,Yu Yang,Jiangning Zhang,Xiaobin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CED是一种训练时的对抗性证据审计方法，通过中和物体级证据区域并比较支持度下降，在GRPO中结合答案正确性，使VLM基于具体图像证据而非语言先验或捷径作答，在9个基准和4个骨干网络上超越现有RL后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs常依赖语言先验、数据集捷径或无关视觉上下文回答，而现有的感知后训练方法虽通过全局扰动或注意力代理鼓励使用图像，但未检验采样答案是否在因果上依赖于支撑它的局部证据。

Method: CED通过中和物体级证据区域，并与匹配的非证据区域对比支持度下降，将这一信号与答案正确性结合到GRPO训练中，奖励依赖证据路径而非捷径或干扰路径的正确答案。仅需弱物体级提案，无需问题级证据标注，无推理时开销。

Result: 在九个公开基准和四个骨干网络上，CED优于先前的基于强化学习的后训练方法，针对性分析验证了其物体级信号的有效性。

Conclusion: CED提供了一种无需额外标注、无推理开销的因果性证据审计方法，有效增强VLM的视觉接地能力，为后训练阶段评估和引导模型依赖真实图像证据提供了新思路。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) should answer from concrete image evidence rather than language priors, dataset shortcuts, or irrelevant visual context. Existing perception-aware post-training methods encourage image use through global perturbations or attention proxies, but they do not test whether a sampled answer causally depends on the local evidence that supports it. We propose Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED), a training-time evidence audit for VLM grounding. For each response, CED neutralizes an object-centric Evidence Region and compares the resulting support drop against matched non-evidence Regions. We combine this signal with answer correctness inside GRPO, rewarding correct answers that rely on the evidence path rather than shortcut or nuisance paths. CED uses weak object-level proposals, requires no question-specific evidence annotations, and adds no inference-time overhead. Across nine public benchmarks and four backbones, CED outperforms prior RL-based post-training methods, with targeted analyses verifying its object-centric signal.

</details>


### [78] [ZOMP: Zeroth-Order Multi-Modal Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08060)
*Sajjad Ghiasvand,Yifan Yang,Mahnoosh Alizadeh,Ramtin Pedarsani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ZOMP（零阶多模态提示调优），一种仅需前向传播的查询高效方法，通过联合优化冻结CLIP模型视觉和文本分支的深层提示，利用跨模态低秩重参数化、梯度校正动量项和预算索引秩调度，在5,000次查询预算下超越现有无反向传播提示调优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调CLIP等视觉-语言模型通常需要全模型反向传播，但在内存受限的边缘设备和专有模型部署场景中仅能进行前向传播。现有的无反向传播零阶提示调优方法要么在单一模态中调优提示，要么搜索空间过大导致收敛需要数千次前向传播，不切实际。

Method: ZOMP采用同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）实现纯前向提示调优，核心包含三个组成部分：(1) 跨模态低秩重参数化，通过共享因子将视觉和文本分支的提示绑定，保持有效搜索维度较小；(2) 梯度校正动量项，稳定噪声化的零阶梯度估计；(3) 预算索引秩调度，随查询预算消耗逐步解锁模型容量。

Result: 在13个视觉-语言基准任务、配对的5,000次查询预算下，ZOMP在少样本准确率和查询效率上一致优于现有无反向传播提示调优方法，并在基类到新类、跨数据集迁移和分布外场景中表现出更好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合利用多模态性和低秩结构是实现实用、查询高效的无反向传播提示调优的有效途径。

Abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language models such as CLIP typically requires backpropagation (BP) through the full model, which is infeasible when only forward-pass access is available, as is common for memory-constrained edge devices and proprietary model deployments. Prior BP-free, zeroth-order prompt-tuning methods avoid this requirement but often tune prompts in a single modality or optimize over a search space large enough that convergence requires thousands of forward passes, which is impractical under realistic query budgets. We propose ZOMP (Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning), a query-efficient, fully forward-only method that tunes deep prompts in both the vision and text branches of a frozen CLIP model using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation. ZOMP combines three ingredients: a cross-modal low-rank reparameterization that ties the two branches through a shared factor and keeps the effective search dimensionality small, a gradient-correction momentum term that stabilizes the noisy zeroth-order estimate, and a budget-indexed rank schedule that unlocks capacity as the query budget is spent. Across 13 vision-language benchmarks under a matched 5,000-query budget, ZOMP consistently outperforms prior BP-free prompt-tuning methods in both few-shot accuracy and query efficiency, and it generalizes better across base-to-new, cross-dataset transfer, and out-of-distribution settings. Our results show that jointly exploiting multimodality and low-rank structure is an effective route to practical, query-efficient BP-free prompt tuning.

</details>


### [79] [NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08068)
*Taigo Sakai,Kazuhito Hotta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroGuard是一种无需额外可学习参数的任务边界更新控制方法，通过自适应梯度缩放、置信度排序的知识蒸馏重加权和脆弱性混合熵门控三个组件，在五个LT-CIL设置中全面提升了DGR基线的任务无关准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长尾类别增量学习（LT-CIL）方法主要关注重放、分类器或损失函数的设计，而忽略了特征表示在每个任务边界处应被更新的强度这一关键因素。作者希望探索是否可以通过控制任务边界的特征更新强度来提升LT-CIL性能。

Method: NeuroGuard包含三个组件：(1) 自适应梯度缩放（AGS）将教师模型的不确定性转化为任务级别的梯度缩放系数；(2) 置信度排序的知识蒸馏重加权（CRK）对教师预测不够果断的重放样本赋予更大的蒸馏权重；(3) 脆弱性混合熵门控（FBE）将旧记忆泄漏信息纳入缩放决策。该方法直接添加到DGR基线之上，不引入任何可学习参数。

Result: 在五个LT-CIL设置中，NeuroGuard在每个设置上都优于DGR基线。在四个主要基准比较中取得了最佳的任务无关准确率。旧类和新类准确率均获得提升，且中频类准确率在五个设置中一致改善。对照实验表明性能增益并非来自通用梯度抑制，AGS在五个设置中均优于匹配的固定缩放控制。

Conclusion: 任务边界特定的特征更新强度控制是LT-CIL中一个有效且被忽视的维度。NeuroGuard证明，通过智能地按任务调整梯度缩放和蒸馏权重，可以在不增加模型复杂度的前提下显著提升长尾增量学习的性能。

Abstract: Long-tailed class-incremental learning (LT-CIL) must learn new classes from imbalanced streams while retaining old classes. Existing methods mainly change replay, classifiers, or losses. We study a different factor, namely how strongly the feature representation should be updated at each task boundary. We propose NeuroGuard, an update-control method added to DGR, a replay-based LT-CIL baseline, without adding learnable parameters. NeuroGuard preserves DGR's replay memory, classifier, and set of loss terms. Adaptive Gradient Scaling (AGS) converts teacher uncertainty into one task-wise gradient scale. Confidence-Ranked Knowledge Distillation Reweighting (CRK) gives larger knowledge-distillation weights to replay samples that the teacher predicts less decisively. Fragility-Blended Entropy Gate (FBE) adds old-memory leakage to the scale decision. Across five LT-CIL settings, NeuroGuard improves over DGR in every setting. In the four main benchmark comparisons, it achieves the best task-agnostic accuracy among the compared methods. The gains extend to both old- and new-class accuracy, while medium-frequency accuracy improves consistently across all five settings. Controlled comparisons show that the gain does not come from generic gradient suppression: AGS outperforms a matched fixed-scale control in all five settings, demonstrating that boundary-specific scaling is more effective than applying the same average scale throughout learning.

</details>


### [80] [SCTD 3.0: Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild - A Large-Scale, Multi-Scene Dataset from Real Marine Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08106)
*Peng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCTD 3.0，一个大规模真实测量的合成孔径声呐（SAS）数据集，包含超过10,000张高质量SAS图像片段，覆盖十个典型目标类别、多种海底地貌、多视角/距离/频段，并配套严格的分层标注协议和多任务基准，旨在填补水下目标识别领域大规模高质量数据集的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成孔径声呐（SAS）对水下小目标广域探测至关重要，但大规模高质量SAS数据集稀缺，现有基准规模小且限于单一场景，无法复现真实探测中复杂的声学散射、多样化海底和多姿态成像，严重制约了数据驱动的识别方法发展。

Method: 构建了SCTD 3.0数据集：1）从多频段系统（240 kHz、450 kHz等）采集超过10,000张真实的SAS图像片段；2）覆盖十类典型目标和多种海底地貌，包含多观测角度、探测距离和频段；3）建立了严格的分层标注协议，将固有物理属性、部署特征和散射现象的标签解耦，涵盖材料、几何形状、内部结构、掩埋状态、阴影完整性、镜面高光、边缘衍射和共振效应；4）构建了多任务基准，评估目标检测、细粒度分类和属性预测，并测试主流深度学习模型在跨域、跨场景、跨频段和跨视角泛化能力。

Result: 多任务基准测试评估了主流深度学习模型在检测、分类和属性预测任务上的表现，并系统分析了模型在跨域、跨场景、跨频段和跨视角条件下的泛化性能，为水下目标感知提供了全面的评测基准。

Conclusion: SCTD 3.0作为大规模真实测量的SAS基准数据集，可为开放水域环境下稳健的水下目标感知提供关键数据基石，推动数据驱动的声呐目标识别研究发展，并已公开在GitHub上供研究社区使用。
