### [181] [Right Answer, Wrong Heat: Explanation-Aware Evaluation and Thermal-Grounded Feedback for MLLMs on Infrared Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09145)
*Yongsong Huang,Xiaofeng Liu,Tomo Miyazaki,Yaohou Fan,Shinichiro Omachi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在红外图像应用中仅以答案准确率评估的不足，提出了一个区分答案正确性、输出级解释接地性和热成像接地性的评估框架，并设计了免训练的热接地反馈机制（TGF）来改进解释质量而不改变答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在红外图像任务中的评估仅关注答案准确性，但正确答案并不能保证模型解释基于真实红外热证据，模型可能依赖可见光特征或弱证据来作答。

Method: 提出了解释感知的评估框架，包含三个维度：答案正确性、输出级解释接地性、热成像接地性。采用双LLM共识判定器（Dual-LLM Consensus Judge）并辅以人工锚定校准检查。在此基础上提出免训练的TGF反馈循环，诊断解释端故障并修订解释，同时保持所选答案不变。

Result: 研究发现：（1）正确答案仍可能依赖薄弱或可见光证据；（2）去除红外原图仅保留可见光风格渲染会削弱热接地性而准确率几乎不变；（3）这种削弱在能力更强的模型中最为显著，但当红外图像可用时消失。TGF在配对输入验证中能改进解释端接地性且不改变答案。

Conclusion: 未来面向红外场景理解的可信MLLMs应当被评估和开发为产生热接地的解释，而非仅仅追求准确答案。

Abstract: General-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to infrared images, where they are commonly scored by answer accuracy alone. However, a correct answer does not ensure that the model's explanation is grounded in infrared thermal evidence. We introduce an explanation-aware evaluation framework that separates answer correctness, output-level explanation groundedness, and thermal grounding for infrared visual questions. Using a Dual-LLM Consensus Judge with a preliminary human-anchor calibration check, we find that correct answers can still rely on weak or visible-light evidence; withholding the original infrared image and showing only a visible-like rendering erodes thermal grounding with little accuracy change; and this erosion is observed most strongly for more capable models but disappears when infrared remains available. We further propose Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF), a training-free feedback loop that diagnoses explanation-side failures and revises the explanation while preserving the selected answer. On local paired-input validation, TGF improves explanation-side grounding without changing answers. These findings suggest that future trustworthy MLLMs for infrared scene understanding should be evaluated and developed to produce thermally grounded explanations rather than merely accurate answers.

</details>


### [182] [Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09146)
*Tianchen Deng,Chongdi Wang,Nailin Wang,Lei Zhao,Ziqi Ma,Tianjun Zhang,Zhe Liu,Danwei Wang,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种大规模神经SLAM系统，采用多子图架构和双层回环闭合机制，结合渐进式映射策略、光流跟踪模块、基于基础模型的局部到全局回环闭合框架以及子图间在线蒸馏算法，在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上验证了其在重建质量和定位鲁棒性方面优于现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于NeRF的SLAM方法在小规模场景重建中表现出色，但扩展到大规模、复杂环境时面临灾难性遗忘和累积轨迹漂移两大挑战，亟需一种可扩展的神经SLAM解决方案。

Method: 提出多子图架构与渐进式映射策略动态分配神经子图以避免内存爆炸；引入基于光流的跟踪模块应对剧烈运动；设计局部到全局回环闭合框架，利用基础模型提取全局描述子以增强不同视角下的重定位精度；开发子图间在线蒸馏算法在后端优化中强制执行子图边界处的几何与外观一致性。

Result: 在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上进行广泛评估，包括在板载计算单元上的直接部署，结果显示该方法在重建质量和定位鲁棒性方面优于现有最先进的神经SLAM方法。

Conclusion: 该系统为真实世界机器人感知和数字孪生提供了可扩展的解决方案，并承诺公开代码。

Abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based SLAM has demonstrated impressive results in small-scale scene reconstruction, yet scaling these methods to extensive, complex environments remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting and accumulated trajectory drift. This paper presents a robust, large-scale neural SLAM system featuring a multi-submap architecture and a dual-tier loop closure mechanism. Specifically, we propose a progressive mapping strategy that dynamically allocates neural submaps to maintain high-fidelity representations without memory explosion. For robust pose estimation, an optical-flow-based tracking module is integrated to handle aggressive motions. To address global consistency, we introduce a local-to-global loop closure framework leveraging the foundation model for high-performance global descriptor extraction, significantly enhancing relocalization accuracy under varying viewpoints. Furthermore, an inter-submap online distillation algorithm is designed during back-end optimization to enforce geometric and appearance consistency across overlapping submap boundaries. To validate the system, we developed a customized handheld mechatronic platform and conducted extensive evaluations on both public benchmarks and our large-scale indoor-outdoor datasets. Experimental results, including direct deployment on an onboard computing unit, demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art neural SLAM methods in reconstruction quality and localization robustness, providing a scalable solution for real-world robotic perception and digital twinning. We will release the code publicly on \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM} .

</details>


### [183] [RefineAny3D: Depth Refinement as Semantic Alignment for Monocular 3D Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09147)
*Zhihao Zhang,Gengwei Zhang,Tianlong Chen,Xiaoming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RefineAny3D，一种基于视觉语言模型的单目3D物体检测深度精炼方法。核心洞察是深度误差在图像空间中具有直接的视觉特征——正确放置的3D框在图像投影上会紧密包围物体，因此将深度修正转化为视觉对齐问题而非数值回归问题。通过扩展VLM词汇表加入动作token，并在大规模链式推理数据上训练，RefineAny3D作为后处理步骤能一致提升闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度基础模型虽具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但缺乏3D检测所需的物体级精度——当用最先进的深度基础模型替代检测器自身的深度预测时，精度反而下降。作者因此认为不应端到端地推动检测器或深度模型更精确，而应将物体级深度精炼作为独立任务来处理。

Method: RefineAny3D是一种基于视觉语言模型的方案：1）核心思想是将深度精炼转化为视觉对齐问题——正确放置的3D框投影后紧密包围物体，过远的框投影偏小，过近的框投影偏大；2）扩展VLM词典加入动作token，用分类决策替代数值深度输出；3）在大规模链式推理数据集上训练，使每个决策都基于显式的视觉证据。

Result: 作为单一的后处理步骤，RefineAny3D在闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具上均带来一致的性能提升，且无需重新训练即可泛化到新类别、新场景和新相机。

Conclusion: 深度精炼不必依赖于数值回归，通过利用深度误差在图像空间中可观测的视觉特征，将问题重新表述为视觉对齐任务，可以用VLM有效解决，实现跨检测框架的通用、零训练泛化能力。

Abstract: Monocular 3D object detection spans two regimes: closed-set detectors operating within a fixed category vocabulary, and open-vocabulary detectors that localize arbitrary categories by leveraging depth foundation models for 3D geometry. We find that current depth foundation models, despite their strong zero-shot generalization, lack the object-level precision 3D detection demands: substituting a state-of-the-art depth foundation model for a strong detector's predicted depth degrades accuracy, even falling below the detector's own prediction. Rather than pushing detectors or depth models to be more accurate end-to-end, we treat object-level depth refinement as a stand-alone task and present RefineAny3D, a vision-language model that corrects depth without ever predicting a numerical value. Our key insight is that depth error has a direct visual signature in image space: when projected onto the image, a correctly placed box tightly encloses the object, while a too-far box projects too small and a too-close box projects too large. Depth refinement thus reduces to a visual alignment problem rather than a metric regression problem, which we instantiate by extending the VLM's vocabulary with action tokens that replace numerical depth output with categorical decisions, and by supervising the model on a large-scale chain-of-thought dataset that grounds each decision in explicit visual evidence. Applied as a single post-hoc step, RefineAny3D delivers consistent gains across closed-set detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, and 3D auto-labeling tools, and generalizes to novel categories, scenes, and cameras without retraining.

</details>


### [184] [OGG-FR: Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09150)
*Yongsong Huang,Qingzhong Wang,Xiaofeng Liu,Tomo Miyazaki,Yaohou Fan,Shinichiro Omachi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OGG-FR，一种即插即用的优化框架，通过将频率梯度分解为冗余平行分量和正交创新分量，解决无人机红外图像超分辨率中像素域与频域损失梯度冲突导致的训练不稳定问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机红外图像超分辨率需要在资源受限平台上部署轻量模型，但多损失训练不稳定。常见的像素域+频域损失组合中，红外图像的低对比度、有限高频内容和传感器噪声导致梯度弱对齐或冲突。

Method: 将频率梯度分解为与像素梯度平行的冗余分量和正交创新分量；在冲突区域使用MGDA计算安全基础梯度并加入方差修正的正交创新；在兼容区域丢弃冗余平行信息，根据高频残差估计的置信度注入正交创新。

Result: 在无人机热成像基准上，BI和BD退化条件、×4和×8倍数下均取得广泛性能提升，梯度分析支持所提冲突感知更新规则的有效性。

Conclusion: OGG-FR作为即插即用框架能有效解决多损失优化的梯度冲突问题，为红外超分辨率在轻量模型上的稳定训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared image super-resolution aims to recover weak thermal structures for deployment on resource-constrained platforms; lightweight models are therefore preferred, but multi-loss training can be unstable. A common strategy combines pixel-domain and frequency-domain objectives; however, low contrast, limited high-frequency content, and sensor-specific noise often make their gradients weakly aligned or conflicting. To address this optimization ambiguity, we propose Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification (OGG-FR), a plug-and-play optimization framework that decomposes the frequency gradient into a redundant parallel component and an orthogonal innovation component relative to the pixel gradient. In the conflict regime, OGG-FR computes a safe base gradient using the Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) and adds a variance-rectified orthogonal innovation; in the compatible regime, it discards redundant parallel information and injects the orthogonal innovation according to a confidence score estimated from the high-frequency residual. Experimental results on the UAV thermal benchmark show broad gains under BI and BD degradations at $\times 4$ and $\times 8$ scales, while gradient analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed conflict-aware update rule.

</details>


### [185] [LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09152)
*Yulun Zhang,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Wenbo Wang,Zihang Qiu,Zhilin Wang,Ruxin Wang,Yupeng Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LightAIR网络，通过轻量级动作反演算子提取纯动作特征、正交零空间投影实现外观-动作严格解耦、以及黎曼梯度矫正模块切断捷径学习，在TPAS和TIPR数据集上显著超越现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本行人搜索仅匹配静态外观属性，忽略动态动作信息。现有TPAS方法存在三大局限：外部显式姿态估计器在监控场景下脆弱、隐式学习面临像素级纠缠下的视觉解耦失败、以及"同外观不同动作"难负样本在欧氏空间中的对比优化引发严重的捷径学习。

Method: 提出轻量级动作反演与黎曼矫正网络(LightAIR)，包含三个核心模块：(1)以文本语义先验为锚点的轻量级动作反演算子提取纯动作特征，克服视觉固有耦合；(2)采用正交零空间投影将外观特征约束在动作特征的正交补空间中，保证严格前向解耦；(3)设计梯度矫正模块，计算黎曼梯度约束反向传播轨迹，迫使梯度流沿保持解耦性质的切空间更新，切断有害捷径。

Result: 在广泛使用的TPAS和TIPR数据集上进行了大量实验，LightAIR显著优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源。

Conclusion: LightAIR通过从特征提取到梯度更新的全方位解耦设计，有效解决了文本行人异常搜索中外观信息污染动作特征以及捷径学习的核心问题，验证了动作-外观解耦在行人异常搜索任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Traditional Text-based Person Search (TPS) is typically limited to matching static appearance attributes, severely neglecting dynamic action information. The Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) task bridges this gap, requiring models to locate micro-level specific abnormal behaviors while matching macro-level appearance of pedestrians. However, current TPAS methods face fundamental limitations: external explicit pose estimators are fragile in unconstrained surveillance scenarios, and implicit learning encounters visual decoupling failure under pixel-level entanglement, causing dominant appearance information to easily swallow and contaminate subtle action features. Furthermore, performing contrastive optimization on hard negative samples (``same appearance, different actions'') in conventional Euclidean spaces induces severe shortcut learning. To address these, we propose the Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian rectification network (LightAIR). First, it introduces textual semantic priors as anchors via a lightweight action inversion operator to extract pure action features, thereby overcoming visual-inherent coupling. Subsequently, it employs orthogonal null-space projection to constrain appearance features within the orthogonal complement space of action features, guaranteeing strict forward decoupling. Finally, we designed a gradient rectification module that computes the Riemannian gradient to constrain the backpropagation trajectory, forcing the gradient flow to update strictly along the tangent space that preserves decoupling properties, thereby cutting off harmful shortcuts. Extensive experiments on the widely used TPAS and TIPR datasets demonstrate that LightAIR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/rainy-london/LightAIR

</details>


### [186] [Not All Visual Tokens Are Equally Safe to Remove:Consequence-Sensitive Visual Token Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09176)
*Jingbo Wen,Liang He,Mingyu Cao,Haoyu Wang,Minxuan Hu,Kangning Cui,Xilu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"后果敏感"的视觉token压缩方法，根据任务的潜在错误成本而非仅平均准确率来分配视觉计算预算。通过先校准后分配的两阶段流程，在总token预算不变的情况下将高后果错误从0.300降至0.133，并在多个基准和架构上验证了其泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法基于注意力、冗余和不确定性等标准优化平均准确率，隐含假设所有错误代价相同。但现实中预测错误的后果往往不对称（如误读发票金额远比误判背景颜色严重），因此需要根据请求的潜在错误成本来分配视觉计算资源。

Method: 采用"校准-再分配"两阶段流程：离线阶段估计不同后果等级的错误预算曲线；在线阶段利用问题或任务信息中的后果信号，为每个请求分配校准后的token预算。该方法通过内容驱动的分配器无法实现的后果信号来区分高、低后果问题。

Result: 在受控基准上，高后果错误从0.300降至0.133（相同总token预算），而内容驱动分配器不优于均匀分配。在实际混合工作负载中，后果敏感分配将代价加权错误降低38%，延迟比全分辨率推理低约21%。该分配原则在三个密集视觉语言基准、两种预算实现机制（token删除和分辨率重分配）、两种VLM架构和多种token选择策略上均表现良好。

Conclusion: 当错误代价相等时均匀分配最优，随着代价差距增大，将token转移至高后果问题越来越有利。所提出的后果敏感token压缩原则具有良好泛化性，为VLM视觉计算分配提供了基于后果意识的新方向。

Abstract: Visual token compression for vision--language models (VLMs) has largely relied on criteria such as attention, redundancy, and uncertainty to maximize average accuracy under a fixed compute budget, implicitly assuming that all errors carry equal cost. However, the consequence of an incorrect prediction on downstream tasks is rarely symmetric: misreading an invoice amount can be far more costly than misclassifying a background color. Motivated by this, we introduce consequence-sensitive visual token compression, which allocates visual computation across requests according to their potential error costs. Our method follows a calibrate-then-allocate procedure, estimating consequence-specific error-budget curves offline and applying the calibrated token budgets online using consequence signals available from question or task information. On a controlled within-task benchmark, high- and low-consequence questions are drawn from the same document images, so content alone cannot reveal which questions are costly to get wrong. In this setting, our method reduces high-stakes errors from 0.300 to 0.133 under the same total token budget, whereas a content-driven allocator performs no better than uniform allocation. Measuring how error rates change with token budget across different cost ratios, we derive an allocation frontier: uniform allocation is optimal when errors are equally costly, and token transfer toward high-consequence questions becomes increasingly beneficial as the cost gap grows. This allocation principle generalizes well across three dense vision-language benchmarks, two budget realization mechanisms (token deletion and resolution reallocation), two VLM architectures, and multiple token selection strategies. On a realistic mixed workload, consequence-sensitive allocation reduces cost-weighted error by 38% while achieving approximately 21% lower latency than full-resolution inference.

</details>


### [187] [Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09182)
*Jingxian Xu,Yuhao Huang,Rusi Chen,Yanfeng Zhou,Dong Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PPOC-LL，一种基于原型学习的渐进偏移校正模型，用于医学图像中的标志点定位。通过多尺度动态感知、相似性驱动的原型学习和误差感知可靠性正则化三个创新设计，在保证高精度的同时显著降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学图像标志点定位方法中，多阶段细化策略虽能缓解单阶段全局预测的解剖学模糊性问题，但其高计算成本限制了实际临床应用，需要一种参数经济且高效的解决方案。

Method: 提出PPOC-LL模型，包含三个关键技术：(1) 多尺度动态感知策略，用于patch级特征金字塔建模，驱动从粗到细的标志点优化；(2) 相似性驱动的原型学习机制，捕获信息丰富的局部语义以处理解剖学相似模式；(3) 基于容差平衡的误差感知可靠性正则化，稳定模型学习并提升整体性能。

Result: 在包含两个公开数据集和一个私有数据集的多种模态（X射线和超声）及多种标志点类型（头影测量、联合胎儿头、胎儿心脏）的大规模验证队列上，PPOC-LL在准确性和模型复杂度之间取得了良好的平衡。

Conclusion: PPOC-LL通过参数经济的原型学习与渐进偏移校正策略，在医学图像标志点定位任务中实现了令人满意的性能，同时克服了多阶段细化方法计算成本高的局限。

Abstract: Accurate landmark localization in medical images is a fundamental step for quantitative clinical measurement and downstream analysis. Existing localization methods have advanced, among which multi-stage refinement is a superior solution. Although this strategy mitigates the anatomical ambiguity inherent in single-stage global predictions, its high computational cost limits practical applicability. In this work, we propose a parameter-economic model, PPOC-LL, which leverages Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction for Landmark Localization. Our contribution is three-fold. First, to drive coarse-to-fine landmark optimization, we introduce a multi-scale dynamic perception strategy for patch-level feature pyramid modeling. Second, to effectively handle anatomically similar patterns, we design a similarity-driven prototype learning mechanism that captures informative local semantics for robust offset prediction. Last, to stabilize the model learning and improve the overall performance, we incorporate a novel error-aware reliability regularization via tolerance-based balancing. We collected a large validation cohort, including two public and one private datasets spanning X-ray and ultrasound modalities, covering cephalometric, symphysis-fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PPOC-LL achieves satisfactory performance with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and model complexity.

</details>


### [188] [RAGMesh with FaME-G2E: Long-Form Text-Driven 3D Face Generation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09186)
*Hao Li,Ju Dai,Feng Zhou,Mengting Shi,Haofei Wang,Zhen Song,Wei Zhou,Lei Li,Junjun Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RAGMesh框架，通过构建大规模多模态数据集FaME-G2E和检索增强机制，实现细粒度文本驱动的3D面部生成与编辑，在局部几何精度、文本可控性、区域编辑精度和推理效率上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D面部生成方法主要对齐全局文本语义与面部结构，难以捕获细粒度的局部形变（如眉毛张力、脸颊收缩、不对称嘴部动作），导致几何保真度和编辑精度有限，长文本描述到细粒度面部几何的翻译仍具挑战。

Method: 首先构建FaME-G2E大规模多模态数据集，包含详细的文本-网格注释和成对的文本-blendshape样本；在此基础上提出RAGMesh检索增强框架，包含两个核心模块：Multi-Scale Retrieval Fusion (MSRF)模块在blendshape空间中检索并融合全局与区域的语义一致面部先验，抑制冲突局部形变并保留连贯形变模式；Adaptive RAG-guided Supervision (AdaRAGS)区域感知约束，显式对齐文本语义与对应面部区域，增强区域可控性与编辑精度。

Result: 在FaME-G2E数据集上的大量实验表明，RAGMesh在局部几何精度、文本引导可控性、区域编辑精度和推理效率方面均优于最先进的方法。

Conclusion: 通过数据集构建与检索增强框架设计的结合，RAGMesh有效解决了细粒度文本驱动3D面部建模中的局部形变捕获难题，为高保真面部合成与编辑提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Text-driven 3D face generation and editing remains challenging due to the difficulty of translating long-form descriptions into fine-grained facial geometry. Existing methods primarily align global textual semantics with facial structures but often struggle to capture subtle local deformations, such as eyebrow tension, cheek contraction, and asymmetric mouth motions, resulting in limited geometric fidelity and editing precision. To facilitate fine-grained text-driven facial modeling, we first construct FaME-G2E, a large-scale multimodal dataset containing detailed text--mesh annotations and paired text--blendshape samples for unified 3D facial generation and editing. Based on this dataset, we propose RAGMesh, a retrieval-augmented framework that leverages text-correlated geometric priors to improve high-fidelity facial synthesis and editing. Specifically, the Multi-Scale Retrieval Fusion (MSRF) module retrieves semantically consistent global and regional facial priors and fuses them in the blendshape space, suppressing conflicting local deformations while preserving coherent deformation patterns. Furthermore, we introduce Adaptive RAG-guided Supervision (AdaRAGS), a region-aware constraint that explicitly aligns textual semantics with corresponding facial regions, enhancing regional controllability and editing accuracy. Extensive experiments on FaME-G2E demonstrate that RAGMesh achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in local geometric accuracy, text-guided controllability, regional editing precision, and inference efficiency. Video demo is available at https://youtu.be/Yr0_XkpWcNk, and the source code and dataset will be released upon paper acceptance.

</details>


### [189] [NBA_Streaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09200)
*Lifang Wu,Yuyang Wu,Yangdong Gao,Fengyu Liu,Ya Jing,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NBA_Streaming基准数据集，用于在线篮球比赛解说生成，包含307小时广播视频和约35K个时间对齐事件，并提出一个因果两阶段框架，结合完成优先定位与以球为中心的语义接地，在持续视频流中实现事件定位和评论生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有篮球解说生成方法主要针对预分割片段或完整视频，不适用于连续视频流场景；同时现有数据集在球员身份、细粒度动作、事件属性和连贯事件链方面的标注不足，限制了生成解说的事实丰富度。

Method: 构建NBA_Streaming大规模基准数据集，包含307小时篮球广播和约35K个时间对齐事件，标注了事件边界、球员身份、细粒度动作、事件链和自然语言解说。并提出因果两阶段框架：(1) 完成优先定位（completion-first localization）从观察到的流中识别完整事件；(2) 以球为中心的语义接地（ball-centric semantic grounding）组织场景、事件、身份和动作线索来生成解说。

Result: 大量实验表明NBA_Streaming具有挑战性，现有基线方法在在线时序、事实接地和细粒度描述方面表现不佳。所提出的框架在强替代方法之上持续提升效果，但仍有差距，说明该基准具有价值。

Conclusion: NBA_Streaming可作为流式体育视频理解和生成的宝贵基准，两阶段因果框架验证了在线解说生成的可行性，但现有方法与理想性能之间仍存在差距，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: Live basketball commentary generation requires determining when an event is sufficiently observable and describing it before subsequent events unfold. However, existing methods are primarily designed for pre-segmented clips or complete videos, making them unsuitable for continuous streams. Existing datasets also provide limited supervision for player identities, fine-grained actions, event attributes, and coherent event chains, restricting the factual richness of generated commentary. To address these limitations, we introduce NBA_Streaming, a large-scale benchmark for online fine-grained basketball commentary generation. It contains 307 hours of basketball broadcasts and approximately 35K temporally aligned events, with annotations of event boundaries, player identities, fine-grained actions, event chains, and natural-language commentary. By moving from isolated clips to continuous streams, NBA_Streaming enables unified evaluation of event localization, response reliability, factual grounding, and commentary quality under causal constraints. We further propose a causal two-stage framework that combines completion-first localization with ball-centric semantic grounding, enabling the system to identify complete events from observed streams and organize scene, event, identity, and action cues for commentary generation. Extensive experiments reveal the difficulty of NBA_Streaming, where existing baselines struggle with online timing, factual grounding, and fine-grained description. Our framework consistently improves over strong alternatives, while the remaining gap highlights NBA_Streaming as a valuable benchmark for streaming sports video understanding and generation.

</details>

### [190] [Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07525)
*Pengfei Zhou,Jiajun Song,Zhiwei Tang,Yixing Ma,Xiaopeng Peng,Donghui Si,Yuhang Xu,Huiqi Song,Yiyuan Miao,Yichen Qian,Weihua Chen,Wangbo Zhao,Bohan Zhuang,Jiasheng Tang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个系统性的评测框架，结合细粒度基准UniHall与自适应多模态模糊测试SAMF，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在动态场景下的幻觉鲁棒性，并揭示了模型在模糊测试下显著性能退化及帮助性-幻觉权衡等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型幻觉评测主要依赖静态基准，存在分类覆盖狭窄和性能快速饱和的问题，无法真实反映模型在动态真实场景中的鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 构建UniHall细粒度数据集，基于统一的分类体系涵盖对象（Object）、指令（Instruction）和知识（Knowledge）三个维度；2) 提出SAMF自适应多模态模糊测试框架，采用进化变异策略探索模型幻觉边界；3) 通过多模态预言机集成的结构化指标套件，确保动态输入评估的可靠性。

Result: 实验表明，最先进的MLLMs在模糊测试下相比常规设置出现显著性能退化，暴露了推理能力与事实依据之间的脱节；同时发现了帮助性-幻觉权衡，即强化学习对齐在指令遵循任务中反而加剧了谄媚行为。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种动态、自适应的幻觉评测方法，弥补了静态基准的不足，并揭示了当前模型对齐策略中存在的潜在问题。框架、代码和基准已开源。

Abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.

</details>


### [191] [DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07527)
*Hongchen Wei,Yuanzhe Wang,Bei Liu,Yifan Yang,Qi Dai,Kai Qiu,Yunsheng Li,Dongdong Chen,Chong Luo,Zhenzhong Chen,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DocAtlas是一个将长文档理解视为可变状态信息搜索过程的系统，通过外部文档环境（包含搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具）来管理证据的检索与利用，在固定上下文预算下结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆。该系统在MMLongBench-Doc上使用GPT-5.4达到71.4%的准确率（超过人类专家65.8%），用Qwen3.5-4B进行端到端强化学习训练后达到63.7%，相比直接输入的54.4%基线有大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统在生成前从静态索引中选取证据，而智能体系统虽支持多轮工具调用但依赖提示词控制的封闭式模型骨架，缺乏对文档信息搜索、读取和存储过程的动态控制能力，难以高效处理跨多页、多布局的复杂长文档理解任务。

Method: DocAtlas将长文档理解建模为可变状态的信息搜索过程，核心是可变的文档环境（mutable document harness）：该外部环境决定每一步搜索、阅读、存储、回顾和展示哪些文档信息。环境提供搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具，维护分层树和笔记存储，并随智能体记录证据而更新。系统结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆，在固定上下文预算下运行，同时支持推理时使用大型VLM以及端到端强化学习训练紧凑型VLM智能体。

Result: 在MMLongBench-Doc基准上，DocAtlas配合GPT-5.4达到71.4%的准确率，超过人类专家参考水平65.8%；使用Qwen3.5-4B VLM在DocAtlas环境中进行端到端RL训练后达到63.7%，相比直接输入基线的54.4%提升了约9.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 可变文档环境设计能显著提升长文档理解系统性能，不仅在与大型VLM配合推理时超越人类专家水平，还能通过端到端强化学习大幅增强紧凑型VLM智能体的能力，验证了将文档理解视为可变状态信息搜索过程的范式有效性。

Abstract: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.

</details>


### [192] [WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07529)
*Yi Zhang,Hongyang Wang,Zheng Hao Leong,Zihao Wu,Kaijun Lin,Zhixing Pan,Qixun Huangfu,Wei Ren,Wenyan Wu,Fangyun Wang,Wenting Yu,Hengyu Lin,Muling Yang,Zongguo Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了WuYuEval，一个面向固体废物管理（SWM）领域的大语言模型多层级评估基准，包含基础知识、领域推理和专家决策三个层面，并通过33个LLM的系统评测揭示了模型在专业决策任务上的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准侧重于通用知识，难以评估模型在工程、环境和政策约束下的专业SWM决策能力，缺乏针对该领域专业判断的评测工具。

Method: 构建包含Foundation Module（4,590道封闭式选择题，覆盖6种任务类型和8个领域类别）和Expert Module（247道基于场景的开放式问题，涉及多目标优化、约束权衡和系统设计）的双模块基准；专家任务采用锚定校准的LLM-as-a-Judge评分与Elo配对比较；对33个LLM进行系统评测。

Result: 最佳模型在Foundation Module上达到94.64%准确率，但平均准确率从简单题的84.14%降至难题的42.50%；薄弱环节集中在计算、实验设计、城市规划和开放式专家任务；推理导向的Thinking模式仅对部分模型配对有正向提升，收益取决于基线能力。

Conclusion: 可见的推理过程只有在锚定于单位、假设和工程约束时才有帮助，否则可能偏离决策边界；WuYuEval为开发具有专业推理链和显式约束控制的SWM领域基础模型提供了评估资源和实证基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

</details>


### [193] [Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07531)
*Cheng Ruoxi,Ma Haoxuan,Zhang Hongyi,Zhang Junming,Duan Ranjie,Xia Qiaolin,Wang Hao,Lu Yu,Shi Haibo,Ma Xingjun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Search-G1，一种基于表征的内在奖励框架，通过两个干预校准的读数（prompt-state读数和answer-commit读数）来衡量智能体回答的操作性接地，在无需过程标注或LLM裁判推理的情况下优化搜索增强语言智能体的检索必要性判断与证据依赖度，改善了接地与搜索成本的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外部奖励要么只提供稀疏的结果监督，要么依赖昂贵的标注或推理；而基于策略侧信号的内部奖励主要反映模型置信度而无法衡量证据接地。作者希望设计一种既低成本又可分级、且真正反映证据接地的奖励机制。

Method: Search-G1包含两个干预校准的读数：一是prompt-state读数，预测闭卷充分性，其补集定义策略相对的检索必要性；二是answer-commit读数，通过删除证据估计回答阶段对证据的依赖度。奖励在检索必要且答案对证据敏感时给予额外信用，在闭卷知识充分时奖励直接回答，并惩罚重复搜索。由于RL会改变策略表征，奖励读数会定期在最新检查点的轨迹上重新拟合，使其与策略共同演化。

Result: 在多个基于搜索的问答基准和两种模型规模上的实验表明，Search-G1改善了接地与搜索成本之间的权衡，在保持竞争性任务准确率的同时产生了更短的响应侧轨迹。

Conclusion: Search-G1证明基于表征的内在奖励可以在无需昂贵外部监督的情况下，有效引导搜索增强语言智能体更接地且更高效地利用检索证据。

Abstract: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

</details>


### [194] [Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07594)
*Guide Labs Team,Andreas Madsen,Aya Abdelsalam Ismail,Giang Nguyen,Isaac Plant,Muawiz Chaudhary,Nathaniel Monson,Saqib Azim,Zhichen Guo,Julius Adebayo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"可解释性是能力的代价"这一传统观点，提出将可解释性作为训练管线的约束条件与语言建模目标共同优化。实验表明在三个数量级的计算规模下，可解释性随能力共同扩展而非对抗。作者实例化了Steerling-8B——一个带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，能够对任意生成 token 组合进行输入归因、概念归因和训练数据归因，支持闭环干预（诊断→检索→概念引导修正），且性能与训练计算量大2-16倍的开放同行模型相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可解释性方法是在模型训练完成后事后进行的逆向工程，其可靠性难以验证。作者质疑这一范式，主张将可解释性直接嵌入训练流程，使其成为训练目标的一部分，从而让模型在训练过程中自然地产生可解释的表征，而非事后补救。

Method: 1) 将可解释性作为约束条件加入训练目标，与语言建模损失共同优化；2) 在自回归和扩散两类语言模型上跨越三个数量级的计算规模进行验证；3) 具体实例化为Steerling-8B——带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，支持输出到输入token、人类可理解概念和训练数据的归因，并能通过概念引导实现无需重训的闭环干预。

Result: 可解释性与模型能力随规模同步提升，模型表征变得更加解缠且与人类可理解概念对齐。Steerling-8B在性能上与训练计算量2-16倍更大的开放同行模型保持竞争力，表明可解释性可以内建于训练并随规模改善。

Conclusion: 可解释性不应被视为能力的"税收"，而可以作为训练设计的一部分，并且随着规模扩大而增强。这预示了一种不同的扩展范式：可解释性可从训练之初就被设计进去，并提供实用的闭环干预能力。

Abstract: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.
  We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.

</details>


### [195] [Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07629)
*Samiratu Ntohsi,Neza David Tuyishimire,Anesu Kafesu,Marvin Ogore,Samuel Oluwajunwonlo Babalola,Oche Ankeli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多语言嵌入初始化的方法，通过平均多个与目标语言类型学相关的语言token嵌入来为NLLB-200中不支持的未见面语言初始化语言token，在Limbum-to-English翻译任务上（chrF2++ = 46.7）取得了与最佳单语言代理token（Swahili，chrF2++ = 47.3）相当的性能，远超从头训练和零样本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLLB-200覆盖200种语言，但仍有数千种语言不受支持，包括喀麦隆的大多数Grassfields班图语。在针对未见面语言进行微调时，实践者需要选择代理语言token，但缺乏原则性的选择方法。

Method: 提出一种嵌入初始化策略：将模型中多个与目标语言类型学相关的语言token嵌入取平均值，作为目标语言token的初始嵌入，应用于Limbum-to-English翻译任务。

Result: NLLB-200零样本chrF2++=12.5；从头训练的Transformer chrF2++=14.5；Swahili代理token微调chrF2++=47.3；平均嵌入初始化chrF2++=46.7。两种NLLB-200变体均比从头训练基线高出32个点以上。所有系统均无法保留声调变音符号。

Conclusion: 多语言嵌入初始化达到了与最佳单语言代理相当的性能，多语言迁移是极低资源班图语言翻译的主导因素，消除了启发式代理选择的必要性；但声调变音符号的保留仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.

</details>


### [196] [SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07641)
*Yuheng Zhang,Yuanchun Wang,Fanjin Zhang,Ruyu Zhao,Juanzi Li,Jie Tang,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SurveyReview，一个与人类审稿人对齐的多维综述论文评估基准与数据集，包含675篇论文和1630份评审报告，并开发了SurveyAlign基线评估器，通过微调Qwen3-32B显著提升了与人类审稿人的对齐度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM自动生成综述论文的规模扩大，评估成为瓶颈。现有LLM-as-a-judge方法缺乏与人类审稿人的系统性对齐，且缺少量化对齐度的系统框架。

Method: 收集并标注675篇综述论文的1630份评审报告，将自由形式的评论转换为四维评分（可读性、批判性、全面性、结构）并附有推理依据；发布标准化训练/测试划分和评估协议；开发SurveyAlign基线，通过对Qwen3-32B进行LoRA微调并融合外部知识来增强知识密集型维度的评估。

Result: 在测试集上，SurveyAlign相比GPT-5.2的提示式评判，将四个维度的平均MSE从2.28降至1.38，MAE从1.15降至0.69，显著提升了与人类审稿人的对齐度。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个多维、审稿人对齐的综述论文评审数据集和可复现的评估框架，并为未来研究提供了具有竞争力的强基线评估器。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address this gap, we propose SurveyReview, a reviewer-aligned, multi-dimensional benchmark and dataset for survey evaluation. We collect and annotate 675 survey papers with 1,630 review reports. We structure authentic peer-review reports by converting free-form comments into four-dimensional scores (Readability, Criticalness, Comprehensiveness, Structure) paired with supporting rationales. We further release standardized train/test splits and an evaluation protocol to measure alignment between automatic evaluators and human reviewers. To validate the benchmark, we develop SurveyAlign, a strong baseline evaluator by fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with LoRA on our annotated data, augmented with external knowledge for knowledge-intensive dimensions. On the test set, SurveyAlign substantially improves reviewer alignment over prompt-based judging with GPT-5.2, reducing average MSE from 2.28 to 1.38 and MAE from 1.15 to 0.69 across all four dimensions. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we establish the first multi-dimensional, reviewer-aligned dataset with a reproducible evaluation framework for survey reviewing; (2) we develop a strong baseline evaluator that substantially improves alignment with human reviewers, providing a competitive reference for future research. Our code and data are available at https://surveyreview.github.io

</details>


### [197] [Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07727)
*Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究从头训练了五个GPT-2架构模型，对比四种达罗毗荼语（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）的单语模型与共享分词器的多语模型，发现单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别上优于mGPT，且分词器效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 达罗毗荼语言在多语语言模型的训练数据中占比极小，模型对这些语言的实际能力尚不明确，需要系统评估单语与多语建模策略的优劣。

Method: 训练了5个GPT-2架构模型：4个单语模型（每种语言独立32K词表子词分词器）和1个共享64K词表子词分词器的四语多语模型，均使用清洗后的CC-100、Wikipedia和Samanantar数据训练，并通过困惑度、每字节比特数、分词器效率和微调结果与mGPT对比。

Result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上均优于mGPT；各语言的单语分词器在效率上也优于共享多语分词器。

Conclusion: 对于数据资源稀缺的达罗毗荼语言，采用单语模型和专属分词器比多语共享模型更具优势，能更好地保留和发挥各语言的模型能力。

Abstract: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

</details>


### [198] [Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09045)
*Xiao Liu,Shiwei Gan,Yafeng Yin,Jiaxin Yin,Bowen Guo,Yaqi Sun,Zhiwei Jiang,Lei Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Uni-SLTP，一个统一的手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP）框架，通过共享手语分词器和统一的自回归生成模型，实现手语与文本之间的双向映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作主要致力于统一多个手语理解子任务（如ISLR、CSLR、SLT），但手语理解与手语生成（SLP）作为方向相反的任务尚未被统一。统一SLT和SLP面临两大挑战：连续手语动作与离散文本token之间的模态鸿沟，以及需要单一条件自回归模型同时处理双向映射。

Method: Uni-SLTP包含两个核心组件：(1)共享手语分词器，将手语序列转换为离散token和潜在表示，同时保留语义信息和运动重建信息；(2)统一的自回归生成模型，将SLT和SLP任务统一表述为条件序列生成问题。

Result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，Uni-SLTP在手语生成任务上取得了优异的运动精度，同时保持了有竞争力的手语翻译性能。

Conclusion: 该工作首次探索了手语理解与生成的统一框架，验证了通过共享分词器和统一自回归模型实现双向手语-文本映射的可行性，为手语研究提供了一个更全面的统一范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.

</details>


### [199] [The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07737)
*Elnaserledinellah Mahmoud Abdelwahab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过形式数学模型证明古典阿拉伯语的非连接形态学中词汇意义由不变词根与形态句法模式唯一确定，并利用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化Saussurean相对任意性，证明阿拉伯语相对任意性可判定且小于1，与印欧语言形成严格系统复杂度不对称，从而反驳后现代关于无限制语义不确定性的主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验后现代主义宣称的无限制语义不确定性及其Saussurean任意符号基础公理是否与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构兼容。

Method: 构建阿拉伯语非连接形态学的形式数学模型；建立形态对应定理（Morphological Correspondence Theorem）证明每个词项由词根-模式对唯一生成；建立语义定位定理（Semantic Localization Theorem）证明词义在派生层面确定；用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化相对任意性，定义为无规则属性；证明一般相对任意性不可判定，而阿拉伯语相对任意性可判定且小于1。

Result: 证明了阿拉伯语中每个词项由词根-模式对唯一生成，词义在派生层面先于表层实现确定；一般相对任意性在形式上不可判定，而阿拉伯语相对任意性可判定且其动机性符号（W和M层级）的可判定任意性严格小于1，与印欧语言相比存在系统性复杂度不对称。

Conclusion: 古典阿拉伯语的形态学架构与无限制语义不确定性的后现代主张不兼容，其相对任意性在形式上是可判定的且受限的，从而在系统复杂度层面与印欧语言形成严格区分。

Abstract: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

</details>


### [200] [Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07763)
*Anna Kołos,Grzegorz Statkiewicz,Karolina Seweryn,Katarzyna Kowol,Karolina Piosek,Wojciech Kusa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了PoVisLE，一个面向波兰语的单文化视觉语言基准数据集，包含1,117张图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA问答对，旨在评估模型在文化情境下超越表层识别的深层视觉语言理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要基于英语中心化数据训练，在处理文化特定含义、符号内容和上下文相关的视觉线索时表现不佳。已有的文化能力基准多为模板驱动且仅关注表层识别，无法有效评估模型在文化情境中的深层语言和语用理解能力。

Method: 构建了一个面向波兰的单文化视觉语言基准数据集PoVisLE，包含1,117张图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA问答对，采用"grounded evaluation"评估范式，强调语言需要在与视觉上下文的交互中进行理解。

Result: 该数据集提供了一个受控且具有挑战性的资源，用于评估文化接地视觉语言理解，能够超越表层识别层面测试模型能力。

Conclusion: PoVisLE填补了非英语文化视觉语言理解评估的空白，为开发更具文化感知能力的多模态模型提供了标准化评测资源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

</details>


### [201] [On the use of foundation models in cognitive science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07812)
*Raj Sanjay Shah,Alex Warstadt,Michael Frank,Sashank Varma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个四阶段推断框架，用于评估基础模型（FMs）作为认知和发展模型的适用性，强调行为对齐本身不足以支撑科学性，必须嵌入明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务和系统性对比评估中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来大量研究评估基础模型与人类认知和发展的对齐程度，但将FMs作为候选认知模型面临方法论和概念上的重大挑战，关键问题在于：行为对齐在什么条件下才能证明FMs作为认知解释模型的合理性。

Method: 提出四阶段推断框架：（1）将人类实验任务改编为模型兼容格式；（2）明确链接假设以映射模型输出到人类测量指标；（3）评估行为对应性；（4）在候选模型或操纵之间进行对比。

Result: 阐明了链接假设在映射模型输出到人类行为测量中的作用，识别了制约对齐声明的挑战，并提出了理论驱动和对比评估的原则。

Conclusion: 行为拟合本身不足以支撑科学性，对齐只有在嵌入明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务和系统性的候选模型对比评估中才具有科学意义。

Abstract: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

</details>


### [202] ["Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07852)
*Adelaide Danilov,Aria Nourbakhsh,Oleksandr Marchenko Breneur,Salima Lamsiyah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了语言模型内部如何表征"说话者"（Assistant、角色扮演人设、叙事故事角色），通过稀疏自编码器提取特征并分析发现：Assistant与角色扮演人设共享核心特征但逐层分化，而故事角色缺乏该核心。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型内部如何表征不同说话者身份（助手、角色扮演、故事角色）尚未被充分探索，本文旨在弥补这一空白。

Method: 使用用户情感表达文本及对应模型回复构建数据集，将Assistant、Roleplay、Story三种生成场景分解为稀疏自编码器特征，在话轮边界和代词标记位置提取特征，通过过滤管线筛选不同深度，并通过转向效应和激活分布来刻画每个留存特征。

Result: 主要发现：Assistant与角色扮演人设并非独立替代关系——人设保留助手关联的特征核心，但从运行机制到行为与风格特征逐层分化；故事角色缺乏助手关联核心；Story和Roleplay可通过沉浸式模拟模式与Assistant区分，但Assistant在默认设置下有时也会进入或缓慢漂移进入该模式。

Conclusion: 说话者表征在语言模型内部并非截然分离，而是存在共享核心与逐层分化的结构，且模型在不同说话者模式间可能出现漂移现象。

Abstract: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

</details>


### [203] [SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07862)
*Debopriyo Banerjee,Kapil Rajesh Kavitha,Angana Borah,Xudong Han,Yuxia Wang,Parameswari Krishnamurthy,Utkarsh Agarwal,Atharva Kulkarni,Swaran Lata,Ayush Munot,Dhruv Sahnan,Aaryamonvikram Singh,Preslav Nakov,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了SurakshaEval，一个针对10种印度主要语言及英语的多语言LLM安全评估基准，包含人工撰写的通用和地区特定提示，并对多种先进LLM进行了基准测试，发现即使强多语言模型在印度语言（尤其是本土文字）中也难以满足细致的安全要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估数据集主要集中于英语和西方语境，忽视了其他语言中的语言多样性和文化相关的安全风险。为了弥补这一空白，需要构建覆盖印度多种语言和文化敏感性的安全评估基准。

Method: 构建SurakshaEval基准，包含覆盖印度10种主要语言（阿萨姆语、孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语）及英语的人工撰写的真实场景提示，既包含印度通用的提示，也包含地区及语言特定的本地化社会文化敏感性提示，并对多种最先进的LLM进行基准测试。

Result: 建立了基线安全性能，识别出反复出现的失败模式，包括过度拒绝、隐含偏见漏检、以及区域敏感场景中上下文意识不足。结果显示即使强多语言LLM在使用印度语言（尤其是本土文字）时也难以可靠地满足细致的安全要求。

Conclusion: 研究强调了迫切需要纳入区域特定数据和结构化评估协议的安全评估框架，以促进AI系统在多样化社会价值观中的安全、道德开发和部署。

Abstract: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.

</details>


### [204] [Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07891)
*Sofija Dimitrijevic,Pallavi Das,Kasey Liu,Foaad Khosmood*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于检测立法委员会证词中自我介绍的机器学习流水线，利用决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三种分类器，结合词袋、位置上下文、结构信号等多种特征，XGBoost取得最佳性能（F1=0.9747），并通过BERT概率特征进一步增强至0.9782。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在政府会议场景下，检测自我介绍并提取说话人姓名对说话人识别任务极为重要，然而该任务缺乏有效的自动化检测方法。

Method: 从五个州立法会议构建154万条话语的训练数据集，使用姓名匹配启发式生成自动标签；提取词袋、位置上下文、结构信号、自我介绍短语指示和语篇上下文五类特征；训练决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三个分类器，并通过微调BERT概率特征进行增强。

Result: XGBoost在三个分类器中表现最佳（F1=0.9747，错误241个）；加入BERT概率特征后F1提升至0.9782，错误降至207个；相比决策树基线（F1=0.9323），主要增益来自语篇上下文特征和提升集成策略；误报分析表明部分真实自我介绍因源数据姓名不一致而被误标，实际性能优于测量值。

Conclusion: 所提出的流水线能够有效检测立法委员会证词中的自我介绍并提取说话人姓名，XGBoost结合BERT增强特征是最优方案，且测量的性能指标略低估了真实表现。

Abstract: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

</details>


### [205] [Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07968)
*Chenrui Fan,Yize Cheng,Ming Li,Yongyuan Liang,Tianyi Zhou,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种考试式评估框架，研究推理语言模型如何在多问题共享推理预算的场景下分配计算资源。研究发现，多个开源和前沿推理模型在跨不同难度和分值的问题间分配共享token预算时表现不佳，模型表现为贪婪的顺序求解器，按呈现顺序优先处理问题，前重后轻地投入努力，对分值不敏感，且这些问题随问题数量增多而加剧。显式规划提示能让计算分配更均匀，但无法产生基于价值和难度的优先级排序。该行为模式从数学推理延伸到代码推理，表明全局预算分配是一种现有按问题评估无法捕捉的独立能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推理模型评估通常一次只研究一个问题上的测试时计算，但真实场景中多个问题共享端到端成本或延迟约束，模型必须决定如何在有限推理预算内跨问题分配计算资源。论文旨在填补这一评估空白，研究模型在多问题共享预算下的战略分配能力。

Method: 引入考试式评估框架，要求模型在一个共享token预算下，跨不同难度和分值的问题分配计算资源以最大化总分。对多个开源和前沿推理模型进行系统实验，考察模型在不同问题数量、难度、分值条件下的预算分配行为，并对比显式规划提示的影响。同时将评估从数学推理扩展到代码推理以验证行为模式的一般性。

Result: 模型在战略性地跨不同难度和分值的问题分配共享预算方面表现失败。它们表现为贪婪的顺序求解器：按呈现顺序优先处理问题，在早期问题上投入过多努力，且对分值不敏感。这些倾向随问题数量增加而更加明显。显式规划提示虽能使计算分布更均匀，但无法产生价值或难度感知的优先级排序。该模式在数学和代码推理中一致出现。

Conclusion: 全局预算分配是现有按问题评估无法捕捉的独立能力，当前推理模型在该能力上仍然存在明显挑战。这为推理模型的评估和训练提出了新的方向，需要关注多问题场景下的计算资源战略分配能力。

Abstract: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.

</details>


### [206] [Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08024)
*Zakhar Mrykhin,Valentin Malykh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出提示嵌入探针（PEP），一种白盒方法，通过在冻结大语言模型的隐藏状态上扩展标准线性探针（加入少量可学习的提示嵌入），实现答案级别的幻觉检测，在多项基准上取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽然能生成流畅有用的回复，但仍容易产生幻觉（hallucination）。现有的基于隐藏状态的幻觉检测方法通常采用标准线性探针，但其检测能力有限，需要更有效的白盒检测方法。

Method: PEP在标准线性探针的基础上，向输入中增加少量可学习的提示嵌入（prompt embeddings），利用冻结的LLM隐藏状态进行答案级别的幻觉检测。评估使用Qwen3模型在多个规模上，涵盖TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA三个数据集，并测试预生成预测、跨模型迁移和分布外泛化等场景。

Result: PEP在主要分布内设置中优于标准线性探针的隐藏状态检测。在预生成和跨模型设置中仍保持有效性，但跨数据集迁移的鲁棒性仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 基于提示的自适应方法可以在保持骨干网络冻结且仅增加少量可训练参数的情况下增强隐藏状态探针的检测能力，为幻觉检测提供了一种轻量而有效的白盒方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.

</details>


### [207] [APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08059)
*Marie Escribe,Tharindu Ranasinghe,Amal Haddad Haddad,Hansi Hettiarachchi,Damith Premasiri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍APEX-VW语料库，这是一个基于NHS虚拟病房文档和Trados Studio专业译后编辑构建的开放英西双语数据集，包含42k词、7个文档、4种MT系统的输出与专业人工译后编辑结果，保留了文档顺序和CAT工具上下文，适用于文档级自动译后编辑及术语纠正传播研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有APE语料库大多在句子层面操作，或为合成数据，无法研究真实CAT工作流中纠正如何在文档内传播的问题。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供保留文档上下文和CAT工具环境的真实数据集，以支持术语规范化、纠正传播和人机协同翻译研究。

Method: 从NHS虚拟病房文档中选取7个文档共42k词作为源文本，使用4种不同范式的MT系统生成译文，由专业译者在Trados Studio中进行受控译后编辑，严格控制MT、术语和质量保证设置，最终构建保留文档顺序与CAT上下文的EN-ES语料库。

Result: 构建了APEX-VW语料库，与WMT APE、eSCAPE、MLQE-PE和LangMark等现有资源相比，该语料库在文档级连贯性和CAT工具上下文方面具有独特优势，可作为文档级APE和传播感知辅助工具的基准资源。

Conclusion: 该语料库为文档级自动译后编辑研究提供了新的基准，特别适用于研究术语纠正传播和人类参与的回译支持系统，未来可在此基础上开展传播感知的辅助翻译工具研发。

Abstract: Post-Editing (PE) of Machine Translation (MT) output often involves repeating the same lexical and terminological corrections across many segments, especially in specialised and highly repetitive documents. Despite substantial work on Automatic Post-Editing (APE), most available corpora operate at the sentence level, others are synthetic, and overall not designed to study how corrections propagate in realistic Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) workflows. This paper presents the APEX-VW (Automatic Post-Editing eXperiments on Virtual Wards) Corpus, a new open English-Spanish (EN-ES) dataset built from recent NHS virtual-ward documents and professional PE in Trados Studio, with controlled MT, terminology, and quality assurance settings. The corpus contains seven document-coherent source texts totalling 42k words, translated with four MT systems representing different paradigms and then post-edited by professional translators. Unlike prior resources such as WMT APE corpora, eSCAPE, MLQE-PE, or LangMark, the dataset preserves document order and CAT-tool context, making it suitable for research on terminology normalisation, correction propagation, and human-in-the-loop translation support. The paper describes the corpus design, data preparation, PE setup, and initial corpus statistics, and positions the resource as a benchmark for document-level APE and propagation-aware assistive tools.

</details>


### [208] [DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08067)
*Yi Shu,Tianyu Peng,Yingzhuo Deng,Wen Yang,Jun Lin,Changming Xie,Xinyu Yu,Jiajun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DialectS2S，一个针对中文方言的端到端语音对话模型。通过构建可扩展的方言语音对话合成流水线，并提出两阶段后训练策略配合自对齐语音监督，解决了低资源方言场景下数据稀缺和语义不一致的问题，在多个中文方言上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端语音对话模型主要针对主流语言优化，在低资源方言场景下表现有限。原因在于方言语音数据稀缺，且方言适配过程中模型的语义表示空间持续演化，而传统语音监督保持不变，导致隐藏表示与语音目标之间产生语义不一致，降级了语音的稳定性和自然度。

Method: DialectS2S包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个可扩展的方言语音对话合成流水线，用于高效构建训练数据；(2) 两阶段后训练策略引入自对齐语音监督，使语音监督的语义内容与模型演化后的语义表示对齐，以提升方言语音生成质量。

Result: 在多个中文方言的语音对话任务中，DialectS2S在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面均持续优于现有基线，取得了实质性改进。

Conclusion: 该工作为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案，并完全开源了包括模型检查点、训练数据集和微调代码在内的完整框架，以促进未来研究和实际应用。

Abstract: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.

</details>


### [209] [Commitment Before Realization: When Classifier-Free Guidance Becomes Unnecessary in Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08082)
*Fan Zhou,Weitian Wang,Tim Van de Cruys*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究无分类器引导（CFG）在带掩码扩散语言模型解码中的必要性问题。通过比较部分输出下继续使用CFG与仅使用基础模型的约束满足概率，定义了"承诺地平线"（commitment horizon），并发现许多提示无需CFG即可成功，而需要CFG的提示其增益往往集中在前期。按每个提示自身的交叉拟合地平线冻结解码，在13个子任务上均不劣于全程CFG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG在掩码扩散语言模型解码过程中全程开启，但其收益因提示不同和时间不同而变化显著。作者希望回答"CFG何时真正必要"这一核心问题，以避免不必要的计算开销并可能减少CFG带来的有害影响。

Method: 从任意部分输出出发，比较在继续CFG和仅基础模型继续条件下最终约束满足的概率，其差值定义了引导的剩余价值。定义了承诺地平线$\astar$作为从该点起切换至基础模型最终成功率降低不超过容差的最早点。利用基础模型下承诺者（committor）是鞅的性质，推导CFG每步效应由引导logit方向与后继承诺者的协方差决定。采用交叉拟合方法为每个提示确定个人化的地平线。

Result: 引导依赖具有高度提示特异性：许多提示无需CFG即可成功，对其他提示无收益甚至有害。对有收益的提示，增益集中在前期。在观察到的前终端地平线中，$\astar$通常较早且在同一约束族内的变异性大于族间的变异性。按提示冻结在交叉拟合地平线上，13个子任务均不劣于全程CFG。对失败轨迹，重新打开已承诺位置在两种失败模式下均能改善恢复。

Conclusion: CFG的收益被高估了：引导的需求是提示特异的且随时间变化，将承诺与实现分离可以大幅减少CFG的使用而不损失约束成功率。边界之后还识别出更高的并行度仅以较小的约束成功代价换取速度提升，但流畅度仍随并行宽度下降。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually kept on throughout masked diffusion language model decoding, although its benefit varies across prompts and over time. We study when CFG is actually needed by comparing, from any partial output, the probability of eventual constraint satisfaction under continued CFG and under base-only continuation. Their difference defines the remaining value of guidance. Guidance dependence is highly prompt-specific. Many prompts already succeed without CFG, while for others it provides no measurable benefit or can be harmful. For prompts that do benefit, the gain is often concentrated early. We define the commitment horizon $\astar$ as the earliest point from which switching all remaining decoding to the base model reduces final success by no more than a chosen tolerance. Under the base model, the corresponding success probability, or committor, is a martingale. To first order, CFG's per-step effect is governed by the covariance between the guidance logit direction and the successor committor. This gives a local account of when guidance can help, but it does not by itself locate the horizon. Among prompts with an observed preterminal horizon, $\astar$ is usually early and varies more within constraint families than between them. Freezing each prompt at its own cross-fitted horizon is noninferior to full CFG on all 13 subtasks at the prespecified margin, even while many tokens remain masked. This separates commitment from realization. The boundary also identifies a later region in which higher parallelism adds only a small cost in constraint success, although fluency still degrades with parallel width. For failed trajectories, reopening committed positions improves recovery in both failure modes.

</details>


### [210] [Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08086)
*Xuning He,Zinan Sheng,Yongding Tao,Huanyu Liu,Ge Li,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Archer，一种无需训练的KV缓存方法，用于支持回滚（rollback）的扩散语言模型（DLM）。Archer通过非对称地复用提示（prompt）的键值状态并保持响应状态同步，在实现2.57倍平均加速的同时，将平均性能提升至33.63%，最高带来3.05个点的Pass@1提升和2.95倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）具有回滚能力，允许先前预测被修正，但每次去噪更新都会改变全局上下文，导致提示和响应状态都需要重新计算，推理成本高昂。传统的KV缓存假设历史状态不可变，难以与回滚机制兼容，因此需要一种新的缓存方法来解决这一矛盾。

Method: Archer采用非对称策略：将可变的响应状态与当前假设保持同步，同时在有界状态邻域内复用提示的K/V键值状态。由于提示的token身份固定（尽管双向注意力下表示会变化），有界复用可以摊销重复的提示计算而不缓存可变的响应状态。此外，该方法延迟了试探性token的反馈，减少了对瞬时高置信度错误的过早强化。理论分析将提示复用刻画为与可逆性对齐的缓存边界，给出状态依赖的近似误差界，以及保持全刷新决策的解码器边距条件。

Result: 在主测试套件上，Archer实现33.63%的最佳平均性能以及2.57倍的平均加速比；在评估设置中，Pass@1最多提升3.05个点，最高达到2.95倍加速。受控实验表明质量提升与延迟提示反馈相关，并验证了状态感知刷新的有效性。

Conclusion: Archer代表了DLM加速从"以质量换速度"到"质量与速度兼得"的转变，通过自适应复用缓存隐藏状态，不仅提升了推理效率，还意外地通过延迟反馈机制改善了生成质量。代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) iteratively refine a sequence, allowing earlier predictions to be revised as context evolves. This rollback capability distinguishes them from irreversible autoregressive generation, but makes inference costly. Every denoising update alters the global context, forcing both prompt and response states to be recomputed even though only response tokens are revisable. Key-value (KV) caching could reduce this cost, yet conventional caching assumes immutable historical states and is therefore difficult to reconcile with rollback.In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free KV caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer asymmetrically keeps the mutable response synchronized with the current hypothesis while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded state neighborhood. Although prompt representations also change under bidirectional attention, their token identities remain fixed; bounded reuse therefore amortizes repeated prompt computation without caching mutable response states. It also delays feedback from tentative tokens, reducing premature reinforcement of transient high-confidence errors and giving rollback more opportunity to correct them. Our analysis characterizes prompt reuse as a reversibility-aligned cache boundary, bounds its state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions.Existing DLM acceleration often trades quality for speed. Archer shifts this frontier, attaining the best mean performance of 33.63% together with a 2.57x mean speedup on the main suite. Across evaluated settings, it improves Pass@1 by up to 3.05 points and reaches up to 2.95x speedup. Controlled analyses connect the quality gain to delayed prompt feedback and validate state-aware refresh. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer.

</details>


### [211] [Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08090)
*Rama Alomair,Remas Alsubaie,Walaa Saifalislam,Rima Alsonbul,Mona Alnajjar,Razan Aldossari,Haya Alibrahim,Abeer Aldayel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究多语言监督对谚语比喻识别的影响，使用742个谚语概念和6,787个翻译实例（涵盖7种语言），评估5种模型，并引入四维注释框架（隐喻、道德/建议、因果、文化特定）来描述谚语。研究发现约50%的翻译多语言训练数据即可达到接近最优性能，结合多样比喻形式效果最佳，文化特定这一最少见的比喻形式在多语言监督下收益最大，且道德/建议和文化特定形式对指令微调LLM的贡献最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言比喻识别方法虽已存在，但对于超越同质语言训练数据时，翻译多语言监督的具体贡献尚不清楚。作者旨在通过系统实验理解多语言监督在谚语比喻识别中的作用。

Method: 使用742个谚语概念和6,787个翻译实例，覆盖7种语言；评估5种模型（包括多语言编码器和指令微调LLM），在逐步增加多语言监督水平的条件下进行；同时引入四维注释框架（Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, Culture Specific）来描述谚语。

Result: 约50%的翻译多语言训练数据即可达到接近最优的比喻识别性能；结合多样比喻形式可获得最强整体性能；最不常见的文化特定形式在多语言监督下性能提升最大；道德/建议和文化特定形式对指令微调LLM表现贡献最大。

Conclusion: 研究启示多语言比喻识别应超越以隐喻为中心的现有分类体系，转向概念层面的多维框架，明确建模互补的比喻意义形式。

Abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances in seven languages. We evaluate five models, including multilingual encoders and instruction tuned LLMs, under progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce a multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes them through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture Specific.
  Our findings show that approximately 50% of the translated multilingual training data is sufficient to achieve near-optimal figurative language identification performance. We further show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form, Culture Specific, exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the Moral/Advisory and Culture Specific forms contribute most to the performance of instruction-tuned LLMs on figurative language identification. These findings motivate multilingual figurative language identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meaning.

</details>


### [212] [NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08107)
*Jiayue Jin,Jingwei Zhang,Chen Wang,Jing Liu,Longteng Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuPAT框架，通过神经元级可塑性分配来缓解多模态扩展对LLM语言能力的退化，在恢复94.5%语言能力的同时保持多模态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态扩展LLM虽然赋予新感知能力，但往往会损害预训练阶段获得的语言智能。现有方法缺乏对内部适应动力学的理解，无法有效在语言能力保留和多模态适应之间取得平衡。

Method: NeuPAT通过两个阶段实现：首先进行小规模探测阶段来估计各神经元的适应模式（区分语言敏感神经元和可塑性较强的神经元），然后在多模态指令微调阶段施加神经元级别的更新约束，选择性保护语言敏感神经元，同时让可塑性强的神经元承担更多多模态知识适应。

Result: 在多种LLM家族的实验中，NeuPAT在11个语言基准上恢复了普通微调所导致的语言能力退化的94.5%，同时维持了相当的多模态性能。

Conclusion: NeuPAT提供了一种轻量级、架构无关的有效方案，实现了能力保留的多模态扩展，揭示了LLM内部神经元可塑性异质性这一关键洞察。

Abstract: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.

</details>


### [213] [Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08160)
*Yingpeng Ma,Jianhao Yan,Bei Shi,Ka Hou Kam,Runnan Wang,Xuebo Liu,Yulong Chen,Yue Zhang,Derek F. Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NCP-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在交互式叙事中保持长期逻辑一致性与叙事承诺的能力。实验表明即便是最先进的模型在对抗性干预下也面临严重的叙事一致性失败，GPT-5.2仅达到42%的存活率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在游戏叙事研究主要关注交互式故事生成的开放性，却忽视了一个关键挑战：如何在用户不受约束的干预下维持长期逻辑一致性和叙事完整性。这个问题此前未被系统性研究和量化评估。

Method: 将挑战形式化为叙事承诺保持（NCP）问题，构建NCP-Bench基准，包含100个基于电影梗概的叙事环境。每个环境包含结构化叙事规范（轨迹、承诺、初始事实），可自动检查玩家代理与叙述代理之间交互的全程一致性。

Result: 对SOTA LLM的实验显示存在显著的长期一致性差距：高语言质量不等于承诺保持；在对抗性干预下即使强模型也频繁产生逻辑冲突内容。最佳模型GPT-5.2在20轮后存活率仅42%，事实冲突率40%-68%，且在100轮限制内只有个别运行能满足所有成就承诺。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在长时程叙事一致性方面存在严重不足，语言质量与逻辑一致性脱节，需要一个专门的基准来推动该方向的研究，NCP-Bench为评估和改进模型在交互式叙事中的承诺保持能力提供了基础。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.

</details>


### [214] [STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08164)
*Nuthakki Siva Gopala Krishna,Kanishka Jain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出STEMMA框架，研究知识蒸馏过程中学生模型不自觉地学习教师的自我表征行为，导致输出同质化、偏见和问责问题，并通过多模态多智能体框架和对抗提示评估LLM的自我一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在LLM训练中广泛使用，但现有研究忽视了蒸馏过程中学生模型不仅学到功能性知识，还会学到教师模型的自我表征行为模式，这可能引发输出同质化、模型偏见和问责性问题。

Method: 提出STEMMA，一个多模态多智能体框架，通过角色特定的智能体协作探测不同模型的自我识别行为，并设计了一组手工构建的对抗提示来评估LLM的自我一致性。

Result: 实验结果表明，大多数模型在某种程度上都存在自我表征不一致的脆弱性。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏会传递模型自我识别行为，导致模型在自我表征方面存在不一致性，需要关注蒸馏过程中的行为知识迁移问题。
