Method: 构建双轨基准：CADEngBench-P用于评估参数化零件（B-Rep有效性、工程与DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑、匹配线性静力FEA）；CADEngBench-A用于评估装配任务（关节检索、面边接地、关节框架预测、运动学验证）。在八个多模态、代码能力模型上进行测试。

Result: 编辑提供的CAD比从头生成更容易；复杂编辑和匹配FEA仍具挑战；装配预测常能定位相关区域但无法恢复记录的关节或配合实体。

Conclusion: CAD评估必须测试工程行为而非仅外观，现有模型在工程级CAD能力上仍存在明显不足。

Abstract: A CAD model is not engineering-grade merely because it looks correct. It must satisfy design requirements, respond predictably to parameter changes, support controlled edits, match a reference structural response under a declared analysis, and connect to other parts through valid joints. We present CADEngBench, a two-track benchmark for these capabilities. CADEngBench-P evaluates 300 parametric parts, each used for one zero-to-CAD task and one functional-editing task (600 tasks in total), through boundary-representation (B-Rep) validity, engineering and DFM checks, parameter-family perturbations, functional editing, and matched linear-static FEA in CalculiX. CADEngBench-A evaluates 150 body pairs through ranked joint retrieval, exact face-and-edge grounding, joint-frame prediction, and kinematic verification. Across eight multimodal, code-capable models, editing supplied CAD is substantially easier than generating it, while complex edits and matched FEA remain difficult. Assembly predictions often locate the relevant region but fail to recover the recorded joint or mating entities. These results show that CAD evaluation must test engineering behavior rather than appearance alone.

</details>

### [483] [World Simulator: Queer Erotica and the Absurdity of AI Video Models That Promise the World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07510)
*Adam Cole,Mick Grierson*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一部名为"World Simulator"的视频装置艺术作品，通过将同性色情内容输入AI视频生成管道，揭示所谓"世界模拟器"的系统性盲区。当模型无法识别训练数据以外的图像时，会产生幻觉般的替代画面，将亲密行为转化为厨房电器、奇异建筑等荒诞场景，以此批判AI系统声称模拟世界却对身体的根本性忽视。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对AI视频模型被营销为"世界模拟器"的普遍主张，指出这些系统在训练数据和内容过滤机制的约束下，系统性地排除了人类具身体验的重要维度（尤其是性）。作者希望揭示这种宣称与现实局限之间的诗意张力。

Method: 采用艺术实践方法：将明确的同性色情素材输入AI视频到视频的生成管道，观察系统因缺乏相关训练数据而产生的幻觉输出——将亲密行为扭曲为厨房电器、奇异建筑和抽象肉体等平庸或荒诞的场景。

Result: 作品成功展示了AI模型面对其训练盲区时的行为模式：系统无法"识别"身体性的亲密内容，转而生成超现实替代物。这一过程直观地可视化了合成知识的认知边界。

Conclusion: 该作品不仅质疑了"世界模拟器"这一标签背后的傲慢，还进一步追问模拟本身的价值，提出更具感官性和生命肯定性的表征形式可能为AI与具身经验的关系提供更开阔的可能性。

Abstract: Increasingly, AI video models are marketed as "world simulators," suggesting their ability to model infinite realities. Despite such claims, these models systematically exclude significant aspects of embodied human experience, particularly sexuality. World Simulator is a video installation exploring the poetic friction between these universal claims and the models' inherent blindness. To do so, the work feeds explicit gay erotica into an AI video-to-video pipeline. Lacking the training data to recognize these images, the system hallucinates surreal alternatives, transforming intimate acts into banal scenes of kitchen appliances, strange architectures, and abstract flesh. By visualizing the limits of synthetic knowledge, the work challenges the hubris of the "world simulator" label, asking how a system, trained primarily on large filtered video datasets, can claim to simulate the world while remaining structurally blind to the body. Beyond this critique, we question the value of simulation itself, asking what forms of sensual representation might offer more expansive, life-affirming possibilities.

</details>


### [484] [SAMOT: State-Aware Step Modulation and Optimal Transport Matching for Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08147)
*Kai Peng,Yunzhe Shen,Miao Zhang,Leiye Liu,Wei Ji,Jingjing Li,Yongri Piao,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于音视频实例分割（AVIS）的框架，通过自适应动态步长调制（ADSM）和基于最优传输的匹配调制（OT-MM），分别解决长序列中模态状态变化引起的建模不稳定问题，以及跨模态实例关联中的分布不一致问题，在AVIS基准上取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AVIS任务面临两个关键挑战：一是复杂的模态状态变化破坏了长程建模能力，现有固定步长Transformer和递归Mamba方法缺乏适应性；二是模态间结构和分布差异阻碍了精确的实例级关联，现有隐式匹配方法忽视了分布不一致性。

Method: 提出两个核心模块：1）ADSM通过利用时间变化、跨模态差异和历史上下文自适应调制Mamba的步长大小，在快速响应模态状态变化与稳定长程建模之间取得平衡；2）OT-MM将实例级跨模态匹配显式建模为带熵正则化的最优传输问题，通过log域Sinkhorn迭代求解，并引入MMD正则化以增强分布级一致性。

Result: 在AVIS基准上取得了最先进性能，FSLA提升3.76，HOTA提升2.75，mAP提升2.58，并通过全面的定性可视化验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过自适应步长调制的Mamba架构和基于最优传输的显式匹配机制，有效解决了AVIS中模态状态变化和跨模态分布差异两大难题，验证了所提方法的优越性，并已公开代码和模型。

Abstract: Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation (AVIS) aims to simultaneously classify, segment, and track sounding objects within video sequences. Unlike Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (AVS), AVIS involves instance-level modeling across longer video sequences, introducing two key challenges: (1) complex modality-state changes disrupt long-range modeling, and (2) substantial structural and distributional discrepancies between modalities hinder precise instance-level association. Existing methods rely on fixed-step Transformers and recursive Mamba models, lacking adaptability to modality-state changes. In addition, methods performing implicit matching ignore the inherent distributional inconsistencies. To address these issues, we propose a framework with Adaptive Dynamic Step Modulation (ADSM) and Optimal Transport-based Matching Modulation (OT-MM). ADSM adaptively modulates Mamba step sizes using temporal variation, cross-modal discrepancy, and historical context, balancing rapid response to modality-state changes with stable long-range modeling. OT-MM explicitly formulates instance-level cross-modal matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem solved via log-domain Sinkhorn iterations, and further enforces distribution-level coherence with an MMD regularizer. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the AVIS benchmark (+3.76 FSLA, +2.75 HOTA, +2.58 mAP), verified through comprehensive qualitative visualizations. The code and model are available at https://github.com/happylife-pk/SAMOT.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [485] [Coarse-to-Fine Registration of Jawbone CT and Intraoral Scan Data Using GeDi and ICP with Pseudo-IOS Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07564)
*Sho Mitarai,Hikaru Kayo,Hisashi Ozaki,Yuichiro Imai,Megumi Nakao*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种伪IOS评估框架，通过从CT数据在同一坐标系内生成模拟口内扫描点云，使得真值变换已知，从而实现配准精度的严格定量评估。基于该框架，提出了GeDi粗配准加ICP精配准的由粗到细配准方法，在七个病例上实现亚毫米级平均绝对误差（0.55-0.69 mm），并评估了金属伪影的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 颌骨CT与口内扫描仪（IOS）数据的配准对于数字牙科和口腔外科至关重要，但由于两种模态仅共享有限区域且真实对应关系未知，配准精度的严格定量评估一直受到制约。

Method: 提出pseudoIOS评估框架（从CT生成模拟口内扫描点云，真值已知），并采用由粗到细的配准方法：先用领域泛化局部描述子GeDi进行全局对齐（不依赖初始位置），再用迭代最近点（ICP）算法进行局部精化，同时评估金属伪影的影响。

Result: 在七个病例实验中，单独的ICP从扰动初始位置出发时经常收敛到局部最小值，而GeDi+ICP在所有颌骨和伪影条件下均保持亚毫米平均绝对误差（0.55-0.69 mm）。三向重复测量分析确认GeDi+ICP显著优于单独的GeDi。金属伪影有统计上可检测的整体效应，但对GeDi+ICP的绝对影响较小。

Conclusion: GeDi+ICP的由粗到细配准方法在颌骨CT与IOS数据配准中表现出高精度和鲁棒性，pseudoIOS框架为口腔领域配准精度评估提供了可靠的真值基准。

Abstract: In digital dentistry and oral surgery, the registration of jawbone CT and intraoral scanner (IOS) data is essential for integrating internal bone structure with high-resolution dental surface geometry. However, this registration is challenging because the two modalities share only a limited region in common, and their true correspondence is generally unknown. This uncertainty has prevented rigorous quantitative evaluation of registration accuracy. In this study, we propose a pseudoIOS evaluation framework in which a point cloud emulating an intraoral scan is generated from CT data within the same coordinate frame, so that the transformation between them is known by construction and can serve as a true ground truth. Using this framework, we propose a coarse-to-fine registration method that combines a domain-generalizable local descriptor (GeDi) for initialization-independent global alignment with the iterative closest point (ICP) algorithm for local refinement, and also evaluate the influence of metal artifacts on registration. In experiments on seven cases, ICP alone frequently converged to local minima from a perturbed initial position, whereas GeDi$+$ICP maintained submillimeter mean absolute error (MAE) across all evaluated jaw and artifact conditions (0.55-0.69 mm). A three-way repeated-measures analysis confirmed that GeDi$+$ICP was significantly more accurate than GeDi alone. Metal artifacts had a statistically detectable overall effect, but their absolute impact on GeDi$+$ICP was small.

</details>


### [486] [Bit Allocation Transfer for Perceptual Quality Enhancement of Traditional Video Codecs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07799)
*Runyu Yang,Ivan V. Bajić*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种比特分配迁移框架，利用神经视频压缩模型（DCVC-FM）中的感知损失训练量化步长生成模型，将感知重要性映射为QP图，用于指导传统视频编解码器的块级比特分配，在不修改解码语法的情况下提升感知质量。在HEVC B~D数据集上，相比JM-19.0、HM-16.20和VTM-23.0分别节省20.20%、8.25%和8.37%的MS-SSIM码率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频编码器（H.264/AVC、H.265/HEVC、H.266/VVC）依赖手工设计的率失真优化（RDO）过程，主要最小化均方误差（MSE），但与人类感知质量相关性较差。虽然神经视频压缩方法可轻松优化感知对齐指标（如MS-SSIM），但其高计算复杂度限制了实际部署。因此需要一种桥接两者的方法。

Method: 提出比特分配迁移框架：1）在神经视频压缩框架（DCVC-FM）中使用感知损失训练量化步长生成模型，输入为原始帧和运动补偿预测帧，输出量化步长图；2）从该映射图推导块级比特比率；3）将比特比率转换为传统视频编解码器的QP图，用于块级比特分配。

Result: 在HEVC B~D数据集上，该方法相比JM-19.0、HM-16.20和VTM-23.0分别实现20.20%、8.25%和8.37%的MS-SSIM比特率节省，且使用预测帧时还能获得额外增益。

Conclusion: 该方法有效地将神经视频压缩模型学习到的隐含感知重要性迁移到传统视频编解码器的块级比特分配中，无需修改其核心解码语法，在保留传统编解码器实用性的同时显著提升感知质量。

Abstract: Traditional block-based video codecs, such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC and H.266/VVC, rely on hand-crafted Rate-Distortion Optimization (RDO) processes that primarily minimize Mean Squared Error (MSE), which correlates poorly with human perceptual quality. While neural video compression methods can easily optimize perceptually aligned metrics like MS-SSIM, their high computational complexity limits practical deployment. This paper proposes a novel bit allocation transfer framework that bridges these two paradigms to enhance the perceptual quality of conventional video codecs. Specifically, we train a quantization step generation model using a perceptual loss within a neural video compression framework (DCVC-FM). The model takes the original frame and a motion-compensated prediction as input and outputs a quantization step map. We then derive a block-wise bit ratio from this map and convert it into a Quantization Parameter (QP) map for a traditional video codec. Experimental results on the HEVC B$\sim$D dataset demonstrate that our method achieves 20.20\%, 8.25\%, and 8.37\% bitrate savings in terms of MS-SSIM compared with the standard reference software JM-19.0, HM-16.20, and VTM-23.0, respectively, with additional gains when utilizing predicted frames. Our approach effectively transfers the implicit perceptual importance learned by neural video compression models to guide block-level bit allocation in traditional video codecs without modifying their core decoding syntax.

</details>


### [487] [Integrating spectral and morphological plant features with decision-tree models for early-season cotton biomass and nitrogen status estimation from multi-year UAV data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07801)
*Vaishali Swaminathan,Nithya Rajan,J Alex Thomasson,Amrit Shrestha,Karem Meza Capcha,Robert Hardin,Pramod Pokhrel*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究利用无人机多光谱影像和机器学习方法（随机森林回归与极端梯度提升）估算棉花干生物量、植株氮吸收、植株氮浓度、临界氮稀释和氮营养指数，以支持棉花精准氮素管理。研究发现结合光谱特征与形态特征（株高、冠层覆盖度）的决策树模型在三年的田间氮管理试验中取得了最优验证精度，其中随机森林模型在干生物量和植株氮吸收上表现最佳，而极端梯度提升模型在氮营养指数划分氮胁迫等级方面略有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 棉花精准氮素管理需要季节内监测作物生长参数和氮素状况指标，以决定施肥时机、位置和用量。然而传统的破坏性取样方法费时费力，缺乏高效、非破坏性的田间尺度监测手段来支持关键生育阶段的氮肥决策。

Method: 研究开展了为期三年的棉花氮管理田间试验，在营养生长早期至开花期（肥料施用的关键阶段）获取无人机多光谱影像。提取时空一致的光谱和形态特征（株高、冠层覆盖度），分别采用简单回归（植被指数）、多元线性回归（植被指数+株高+冠层覆盖度）以及决策树模型（随机森林回归和极端梯度提升）估算棉花干生物量、植株氮吸收和植株氮浓度，并使用试验留出法和留一年验证法进行模型评估。氮营养指数由模型估算的干生物量和植株氮浓度计算，用于氮缺乏地块识别和多级氮胁迫分类。

Result: 随机森林回归在试验留出法验证下表现最佳（干生物量R²=0.88，MAPE=23.14%；氮吸收R²=0.84，MAPE=20.61%；氮浓度R²=0.85，MAPE=7.82%），极端梯度提升略次但接近。基于极端梯度提升输出的氮营养指数在识别氮缺乏地块和多级氮胁迫分类上略优于随机森林结果。

Conclusion: 将无人机多光谱影像与机器学习方法相结合，能够有效估算棉花关键氮素管理指标，为得克萨斯州沿海平原的中高秆棉花品种提供精准氮肥决策支持，具有实际的农业应用价值。

Abstract: Precision nitrogen (N) management (PNM) for cotton requires in-season monitoring of crop growth parameters and N status indicators to decide fertilizer timing, placement, and application rates for optimal canopy development and yield. This study developed remote sensing and machine learning-based methods to estimate cotton dry biomass weight (DBW), plant N uptake (PNU), plant N concentration (PNC), critical N dilution (Nc), and nitrogen nutrition index (NNI) to support PNM. To achieve this, a three-year field-based N-management study was conducted and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based multispectral images were acquired between early vegetative growth and flowering stages, critical for fertilizer applications. Spatiotemporally consistent spectral and morphological plant features, including plant height (PH) and fractional canopy cover (FCC), provided reliable model training inputs. DBW, PNU, and PNC estimates from simple regression using vegetation indices (VIs), multiple linear regression (MLR) combining VIs, PH, and FCC, and decision-tree models, random forest regression (RFR) and extreme gradient boosting (XGB), combining spectral reflectance, PH, and FCC were evaluated using trial-held-out (THO) and leave-one-year-out (LOYO) validation methods. The best validation accuracies were from RFRTHO (R2 = 0.88 and MAPE = 23.14% for DBW; R2 = 0.84 and MAPE = 20.61% for PNU; R2 = 0.85 and MAPE = 7.82% for PNC) and XGBTHO (R2 = 0.87 and MAPE = 21.91% for DBW; R2 = 0.81 and MAPE = 21.40% for PNU; R2 = 0.86 and MAPE = 7.66% for PNC). Nc was calculated from model estimated DBW and PNC for high-yielding, medium-to-tall cotton varieties grown in the Texas Coastal Plains and validated using ground-truth biomass measurements. NNI derived from XGBTHO outputs performed marginally better than NNI from RFRTHO in identifying N-deficient plots and multi-level N-stress categorization.

</details>


### [488] [$\texttt{DisMorph}$: learning to disentangle technical distortions from true biological change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08173)
*Jingru Fu,Kathleen E. Larson,Douglas N. Greve,Bruce Fischl,Malte Hoffmann*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出DisMorph，一种完全在合成数据上训练的图像配准框架，能够将纵向MRI形变显式分解为技术和解剖两种变换，分别预测两个稠密形变场，从而分离MRI扫描仪几何畸变（如梯度非线性畸变）与真实的生物学脑结构变化，提高纵向形态测量精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向MRI是研究衰老和神经退行性疾病的重要工具，但MRI扫描仪引入的几何畸变（如梯度非线性畸变）会随采集系统和协议而变化。现有配准方法估计单一形变场，将生物学效应和技术效应混为一谈，在畸变未完全校正时可能使下游形态测量产生偏差。

Method: DisMorph是一个完全在合成数据上训练的双流配准框架：1) 预测两个稠密形变场，分别编码技术畸变和生物解剖变化；2) 提出新颖的生成模型在训练时分别合成两种效应以提供解缠监督；3) 使用域随机化增强跨成像协议的泛化能力。

Result: 在三个互补设置中评估：1) 已知真实值的模拟数据上，比传统配准更准确、更一致地检测解剖变化；2) 仅含GNL畸变的真实图像对上，将大多数几何变化分配给畸变场，在无解剖变化时表现出特异性；3) 纵向阿尔茨海默病数据上，在AD相关脑结构中检测到解剖变化，同时识别出标准校正后残留的畸变。

Conclusion: 通过将MRI诱导的畸变与生物学变化在纵向形变中解缠，DisMorph为临床环境中难以保持采集一致性的纵向形态测量提供了更精确的路径，有望提高临床纵向脑影像分析的可靠性。

Abstract: Longitudinal MRI enables sensitive measurement of structural brain change for studying aging and neurodegenerative disease. Deformable image registration is a key tool for estimating such change by computing a dense deformation that captures geometric differences between longitudinal scans. However, MRI scanners introduce geometric distortions that vary across acquisition systems and protocols, such as gradient non-linearity (GNL) distortion. Existing registration methods estimate a single field that conflates biological and technical effects, potentially biasing downstream morphometric measurements if distortions remain (partially) uncorrected. We propose $\texttt{DisMorph}$, a registration framework trained entirely on synthetic data that explicitly decomposes longitudinal deformation into technical and anatomical transforms. It predicts two dense deformations, each encoding one effect. During training, a novel generative model synthesizes both effects separately to provide disentanglement supervision, while domain randomization promotes generalization across imaging protocols. We evaluate our method in three complementary settings. On simulated data with known ground truth, our method detects anatomical change more accurately and consistently than conventional registration. On real image pairs that differ only by GNL distortion, our method assigns most geometric change to the distortion field, demonstrating specificity in the absence of anatomical change. On longitudinal Alzheimer's disease (AD) pairs, our method detects anatomical change in AD-related brain structures while identifying residual distortion left after standard correction. By disentangling MRI-induced distortion from biological change in the longitudinal deformation, our method paves the way for more accurate longitudinal morphometry in clinical settings where maintaining acquisition consistency is challenging.

</details>


### [489] [Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Based Color Restoration for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08211)
*Li-Wei Lu,Shaou-Gang Miaou*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的通用后处理模块，将颜色恢复与亮度增强解耦，通过从外部高质量色彩知识库中动态检索参考图像并注入其颜色分布，以校正低光图像增强后的系统性颜色偏移（如发绿的天空、发黄的人脸等）。该模块在多个数据集和多种前端网络上均能提升色彩指标，且实验表明基于VGG19双索引的检索优于CLIP检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的低光图像增强方法虽然能提升亮度和结构保真度，但输出仍存在系统性色偏。作者认为根本原因在于端到端训练将亮度、结构和颜色耦合在单一网络中，导致颜色通道缺乏充分监督。因此需要将颜色恢复作为独立子问题解耦处理。

Method: 该方法将颜色恢复实现为通用后处理模块，包含三个组件：(1) 基于VGG19中间特征的双索引FAISS检索器，通过全局均值和方差统计捕获纹理与结构相似性；(2) GlobalSPHistAdaIN，将参考图像的空间保持颜色直方图降维为全局颜色向量，通过自适应实例归一化调制网络特征，避免依赖像素级对应；(3) 残差公式，预测前端输出的颜色校正量。

Result: 在LOLv1、LOLv2-Real和LOLv2-Synthetic三个数据集上，该模块一致提升颜色特定指标；在CPGA-Net++、LLFormer、FLIGHTNet和IAT四种不同前端网络间切换时仍保持有效性，验证了跨前端泛化能力。消融实验表明VGG19双索引优于CLIP检索。

Conclusion: 颜色恢复应作为与亮度增强解耦的独立子问题处理，最好依赖纹理和结构相似性而非高层语义进行参考图像检索。基于RAG的后处理方案在不同前端网络上均表现出通用性，为解决低光增强中的系统性色偏提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods have driven brightness and structural fidelity close to that of normally-exposed images, yet their outputs still exhibit systematic color shifts such as greenish skies, yellowish faces, and warm-tinted white objects. We attribute this to end-to-end LLIE training coupling brightness, structure, and color within a single network, leaving the color channels weakly supervised. We recast color restoration as an independent sub-problem and decouple it from brightness enhancement, realizing it as a general-purpose post-processing module built on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Rather than relying solely on parametric color priors learned during training, the module dynamically retrieves a reference image from an external high-quality color knowledge base and injects its color distribution into a color-restoration network to correct residual bias. The design has three components: (i) a dual-index FAISS retriever built on intermediate VGG19 features, capturing textural and structural similarity through global mean and variance statistics; (ii) GlobalSPHistAdaIN, which reduces the reference spatial-preserving color histogram to a global color vector and modulates network features via adaptive instance normalization, removing dependence on pixel-level correspondence; and (iii) a residual formulation that predicts a color correction over the front-end output. Across LOLv1, LOLv2-Real, and LOLv2-Synthetic, the module consistently improves color-specific metrics, and it remains effective when the front end is swapped among CPGA-Net++, LLFormer, FLIGHTNet, and IAT, confirming cross-front-end generality. Ablations show that a VGG19 dual index outperforms CLIP-based retrieval, indicating that color restoration depends on textural and structural similarity rather than high-level semantics.

</details>


### [490] [Lost in k-Space: An Open-Source MR-Physics Escape Room](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09616)
*Sabine Melanie Räuber,Marta Brigid Maggioni,Francesco Santini*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个以MR物理为主题的医学教育逃生室，在ESMRMB年会上成功运行，39支队伍参与，逃脱率31%，并将全部设计资料开源发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作MR扫描仪需要超越MR物理学的多学科能力（包括安全管理和团队协作），而游戏化教学尤其是教育性逃生室已被证明能提升健康专业教育中的动机、参与度和知识保持，因此作者开发了一个MR物理主题的教育逃生室。

Method: 为ESMRMB第41届年会设计了一个MR物理主题的教育逃生室：每队4人、限时25分钟，还原MR控制室氛围。5个谜题涵盖Larmor方程、序列组成、MR安全和MR序列声学识别。使用定制ESP32电子系统实现谜题间及与游戏主持人的实时通信。

Result: 房间无技术中断运行，39支队伍（约160名参与者）参与，其中12支成功逃脱（逃脱率31%），中位解谜时间为21分53秒。青年研究者担任游戏主持人。

Conclusion: 逃脱率与面向科学受众的同类活动一致。难度可通过调整谜题隐蔽性、组件可用性、所需先验知识和思维跳跃来调节。改进版本可补充强制性MR安全培训，全部代码、原理图、加工文件和文档已开源发布。

Abstract: Introduction. Operating an MR scanner for technical and clinical research requires multidisciplinary competencies beyond MR physics, including safety management and teamwork. Gamification, particularly educational escape rooms, have been associated with improved motivation, engagement and knowledge retention in health professional education. Materials and Methods. We developed an MR-physics-themed educational escape room for the 41st Annual Meeting of the ESMRMB. Designed for teams of four with a time limit of 25 minutes, the room reproduced the atmosphere of an MR control room. The five puzzles covered the Larmor equation, sequence composition, MR safety and acoustical identification of MR sequences. Custom ESP32 electronics allowed the puzzles to communicate in real time with each other and with the game master Results. The room ran without technical interruptions and was played by 39 teams (approximately 160 participants); 12 solved it (escape rate 31%), with a median solution time of 21 minutes and 53 seconds. Early-career researchers acted as game masters. Discussion. The escape rate aligns with comparable activities targeting scientific audiences. Difficulty can be tuned by adjusting puzzle obscurity, component availability, required prior knowledge and mental leaps. A modified version could usefully supplement mandatory MR safety training. Code, schematics, machining files and documentation are released as open source.

</details>
